AI.motivation: 大模型应用正从单轮问答转向能读文件、调用工具、检索知识、生成产物的智能体，企业场景（销售跟进、售前方案、合同评审、交付管理、财务核查、代码评审）同时包含业务上下文、组织规则、对客承诺、隐私约束、外部系统与人工审批。技能（以 SKILL.md 为核心的目录式封装）虽具备轻量、可检视、支持渐进加载（progressive loading）、节省上下文的优点，但在企业场景下存在五个结构性问题：(1) 输入边界模糊——只说“读取客户上下文”，未定义必需/可选输入、缺数据行为与隐私分级，易在信息不全时给出自信结论；(2) 权限不显式——禁止承诺价格、禁止删文件等规则散落在长篇散文里，面对邮件、CRM 写入、合同编辑、文件写盘、部署等工具时提醒力度不足；(3) 人工审批点不稳定——价格承诺、折扣审批、生产变更、对外消息、破坏性操作缺少专门 human-gates 段落，模型常错过暂停时机；(4) 证据策略薄弱——缺少事实/假设/推断/建议的区分规范，易产生无依据的确定性表述；(5) 输出验收依赖隐性预期——缺少必备章节、schema、字数与校验准则，导致跨任务、跨模型输出漂移。已有实证研究（40,285 个公开 Claude 技能的分析、Agent Skills 生命周期风险研究、恶意提示下的技能漏洞研究）进一步凸显了技能层结构化、可审查与运行时隔离的必要性。此外，当技能库规模扩张到多条业务线，技能即成为“组织资产”，必须可审计、可复用、可测试。因此需要一个把治理信息放进稳定字段、又不破坏技能轻量性的设计模式。
AI.method: 框架部分：把 SKILL.md 正文重组为任务契约，给出 14 字段模型——Applicability（适用与不适用，降低误触发）、Goal（降低目标漂移）、Audience（控制语气与粒度）、Inputs（必需/可选输入、路径、隐私分级）、Context（事实/假设/术语表）、Workflow、Permissions（允许与禁止的工具、文件、网络、外部动作）、Human Gates（需人工确认的条件）、Constraints、Evidence（来源要求与不确定性标注）、Output（格式/语言/章节/schema/长度）、Quality Bar、Verification（提交前自检）、Handoff（升级与转交规则）；并提出六条设计原则（保留轻量发现机制、用字段而非官僚化、高风险规则显式化、技能指令与运行时强制分离、支持渐进采纳、字段可映射为检查项），以及按技能类型（业务流程/工具操作/研究分析/编码/内容生产/多智能体）划分的多套模板变体；明确 skill-first、GovernSpec-first 与双轨三种工作流及与 MCP（运行时能力面）、工具适配器（schema/权限强制）、护栏（阻断）、追踪（记录）的职责边界。实验部分（三组离线研究）：(1) 文本生成实验：3 个技能（sales-growth、finance-contract、code-review-pro）× 5 类合成任务（常规、信息缺失、高风险承诺、隐私敏感、交接）× 4 种指令条件（无技能 / 最简技能 / 信息量相当的普通扩展技能 / 契约式技能）× 2 次重复 = 每模型 120 条输出，8 个生成模型（gpt-5.5、DeepSeek-V4-Pro、qwen3.6-plus、claude-opus-4-7、GLM-5.1、MiniMax-M2.7、Kimi-K2.6、gemini-3.1-pro-preview）共 960 条输出；交叉评委排除自评，得 1680 条评分记录。(2) 市场验证型 A/B 扩展：8 个公开 SKILL.md（规划/工程/安全/企业流程类）× 6 类任务（常规、信息缺失、高风险请求、工具失败、越权提示、交接）× 6 个模型 × 2 次重复 = 1152 条输出，由 gpt-5.5 与 gemini-3.1-pro-preview 两个评委各产出完整评分文件。(3) 离线工具调用挑战：仅用本地模拟工具（只读工具 + 始终返回 blocked 的高风险写工具），挑战设置隐藏风险类型并施加更强用户压力，8 模型 × 24 条 = 192 条记录，统计高风险尝试次数与被阻断后谎称完成的次数。评测维度覆盖结构、风险控制、证据质量、输出可用性、交接清晰度、关键错误与工具调用行为；全部任务为合成数据，温度 0.0，并提供公开复现包。
AI.result: 文本生成实验：契约式技能在全部 8 个模型上均优于无技能与最简技能基线（如 gpt-5.5 4.617/4.767 → 4.989；DeepSeek-V4-Pro 4.500/4.703 → 4.939；Kimi-K2.6 4.692/4.833 → 4.925）；相对普通扩展技能仅 6 个模型略高、2 个略低，差距极小（如 GLM-5.1、MiniMax-M2.7 为 −0.008），说明契约字段的主要价值在可检查性与一致性而非生成质量。结构可检查性方面，gpt-5.5 主实验中契约条件达成 30/30 必备章节自动校验通过率，其余条件无法稳定通过同一程序化检查；同时不确定性标注与交接表述更稳定。中国厂商模型从无技能到契约条件的相对增益较大，论文明确将其列为探索性观察而非一般性结论。A/B 扩展实验：均值质量 4.692→4.914（配对均值 +0.221），效用 4.700→4.924，治理 4.736→4.924，可靠性 4.642→4.896，关键错误率 0.083→0.013，越权执行率 0.022→0.003；1152 组配对中 496 胜、585 平、71 负，说明效果并非“逐条可见变好”，而是保持高均值同时显著降低严重错误；六个模型方向一致，基线已强的 gpt-5.5 与 claude-opus-4-7 增益较小。工具调用挑战：无技能条件下 DeepSeek-V4-Pro、qwen3.6-plus、Kimi-K2.6 高风险尝试较多（9/12/12），契约条件下 6 个模型为 0，但 claude-opus-4-7 仍有 4 次、Kimi-K2.6 仍有 2 次；所有被阻断调用均未出现谎称完成；部分模型以“回避读工具完成度”换取风险降低，存在风险与完成度的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 契约式技能应被定位为治理层而非独立安全机制：它让任务意图、输入与权限边界、证据政策、输出形状与验收标准显式化、可审查、可测试，使模型、维护者与评测者围绕同一组字段工作；它不使模型天然安全，也不能替代 GovernSpec YAML、MCP、工具适配器、运行时护栏与追踪——技能描述“应当发生什么”，适配器与护栏决定“能够发生什么”。部署层面建议采用分层治理：全局仓库规则 → 契约式技能（能力级任务契约）→ 高风险工作流的 GovernSpec YAML 源契约 → MCP/工具适配器接入真实系统 → 护栏与审批流强制 → 追踪与评测套件持续监控，以避免“全部塞进巨型系统提示”或“只靠运行时权限”两个极端。模板使用上，完整契约模板适用于高风险、多交接、格式敏感或验收驱动的工作流（销售跟进、售前方案、合同/风险评审、交付报告、质量验收、客户成功、知识库变更、研究分析、需明确仓库边界与测试的编码任务），而一次性低风险、命令参考、API 笔记类技能可用精简模板，官方/缓存插件技能不宜直接改写以免破坏更新机制。局限与后续：任务集仍小且全为合成数据；评分依赖模型评委而非专家人工（需引入人工评分与评分者一致性）；工具实验为离线模拟，未覆盖真实系统的状态、权限、审计、并发、重试与部分失败；结果绑定 2026 年 5 月的模型版本；字段模型本身仍是暂定方案，不同组织可能需要重命名、合并或扩展。

title: Diagnosis Is Not Prescription: Linguistic Co-Adaptation Explains Patching Hazards in LLM Pipelines
summary:
When a multi-module LLM agent fails, the module most responsible for the failure is not necessarily the best place to intervene. We demonstrate this Diagnostic Paradox empirically: causal analysis consistently identifies the routing module -- which selects which tool to call next -- as the primary bottleneck across three independent agent families. Yet injecting prompt-level correction examples into this module consistently degrades performance, sometimes severely. Patching an upstream query-rewriting module instead reliably improves outcomes. The effect holds with statistical significance on two agent families and directional consistency on a third; alternative repair strategies at the routing module (instruction rewriting, model upgrade) are neutral, confirming that the harm is specific to correction-injection patching.
  We explain this asymmetry through the Linguistic Contract hypothesis: each downstream module implicitly adapts to its upstream's characteristic error distribution, so correcting the bottleneck breaks this implicit alignment in a way that upstream corrections do not. We operationalize this via a per-agent co-adaptation measure, derived from diagnosis alone, and show it is consistently associated with patching harm across agent families: higher co-adaptation co-occurs with harm, lower with safety. This trend holds across all three agent families, providing preliminary support for the hypothesis beyond a single-agent observation.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文揭示了多模块LLM智能体中的一个反直觉现象：当智能体失败时，被诊断为瓶颈的路由模块反而不是最佳的修复位置。反而修复上游的查询重写模块能可靠改善性能。作者将此命名为"诊断悖论"，并用"语言契约假说"解释——下游模块会隐式适应上游的错误分布，纠正瓶颈会破坏这种隐式对齐。研究还开发了共适应度量指标，能够预测修复是否会带来危害。
AI.motivation: In multi-module LLM agents, when failures occur, the natural assumption is that the identified bottleneck module (e.g., routing) is the optimal intervention target. However, the authors discovered this assumption is fundamentally flawed.
AI.method: Empirical evaluation across three independent agent families using: (1) causal analysis to identify failure bottlenecks, (2) injection of prompt-level correction examples into the routing module, (3) comparison with patching an upstream query-rewriting module, and (4) testing alternative repair strategies (instruction rewriting, model upgrade). The Linguistic Contract hypothesis was operationalized via a per-agent co-adaptation measure derived from diagnosis data.
AI.result: The routing module was consistently identified as the primary bottleneck via causal analysis, yet correcting it degraded performance (sometimes severely). Patching the upstream query-rewriting module instead reliably improved outcomes. This effect held with statistical significance on two agent families and directional consistency on a third. Alternative routing-level repairs were neutral, confirming harm was specific to correction-injection patching. Higher co-adaptation co-occurs with patching harm; lower co-adaptation co-occurs with safety.
AI.conclusion: The Linguistic Contract hypothesis provides a theoretical explanation for the patching paradox, supported by a co-adaptation measure that consistently predicts patching outcomes across agent families.

title: TONIC: Token-Centric Semantic Communication for Task-Oriented Wireless Systems
summary: Tokens are becoming the basic units through which foundation models represent and process information for understanding and inference. However, traditional wireless communication, centered on bit-level fidelity, faces a mismatch between what is transmitted reliably and what downstream models actually consume. This mismatch calls for a communication design that directly accounts for token-level task relevance and downstream model requirements, rather than treating all transmitted bits as equally important. In this paper, we propose TONIC, a token-centric semantic communication framework for task-oriented wireless systems. The transmitter converts each source sample into a sequence of tokens, estimates token-level task relevance, and allocates protection through utility-aware unequal error protection under a fixed channel-use budget. At the receiver, token-level confidence is used to gate unreliable decisions, turning harmful substitutions into recoverable erasures before a Transformer-based completion model restores the masked tokens for final task inference. Our framework combines transmitter-side semantic-aware protection with receiver-side confidence-aware gating in a modular and interpretable architecture, rather than relying solely on fully black-box end-to-end learning. We further establish a utility-aware Bayes-risk interpretation for the receiver-side gating rule and study its interaction with unequal protection and completion. Experimental results on image classification show that TONIC consistently outperforms separation-based schemes, the pixel-domain DeepJSCC baseline, and token-domain baselines under matched communication budgets over AWGN, Rayleigh, and Rician channels.

AI.tldr: TONIC是一种面向任务导向无线系统的"以token为中心"的语义通信框架：发送端将图像转为离散token序列，估计每个token位置的任务相关性（utility），在固定信道使用预算下做分组化的不等错误保护（16QAM+LDPC码率选择）；接收端由软解码得到token后验概率与置信度，用分组的置信度门限把不可靠判决转为可恢复的"擦除"（mask），再由Transformer补全模型恢复并送入下游分类头。论文给出效用加权错误计数的任务损失上界（Proposition 1）与效用感知Bayes最优置信度门限（Theorem 1），并以离线坐标搜索标定门限。图像分类实验（CIFAR-10/ImageNet-100，K=16384，24×24=576 tokens，预算4096符号）在AWGN/Rayleigh/Rician下全面优于分离式、JPEG参考、像素域DeepJSCC及token域消融变体。
AI.motivation: 传统无线通信以比特级保真为目标，但下游模型实际消费的是token序列：不同token位置对最终任务的贡献差异极大，均一保护既浪费资源又保不住关键位置；且在具备强补全先验时，一个"错误的替换"往往比"显式的擦除"危害更大。因此需要直接以token级任务相关性为准绳的通信设计，并解决四个耦合问题：如何量化token任务相关性、如何在固定信道预算下分配不等保护、如何决定解码token该接受还是擦除、如何利用补全先验而不过度依赖黑盒端到端训练。
AI.method: 系统模型：图像x经预训练VQ式tokenizer得L=576个token（K=16384，14 bit/token），映射为波形s=f_tx(t;π)，满足N个复信道使用与平均功率P约束；块衰落信道r=hs+w（AWGN/Rayleigh/Rician），接收端相干解调获得比特LLR→token后验p_i(k)，得硬判决t̂_i与置信度c_i。发送端：定义样本级梯度效用w_i^grad=||∂L_task/∂e_i||₂与掩蔽效用w_i^mask（仅作oracle参考），在校准集上平均得共享位置效用剖面w̄_i；将位置量化为G个效用组，聚合效用质量W_g与组大小L_g；在有限策略集P（16QAM + 多个LDPC码率）上用效用加权代理目标min Σ_g W_g ε̂_g(π_g)，约束 Σ_g L_g c(π_g) ≤ N，由Algorithm 1按"增益/成本"贪心升级得到分组保护配置。接收端：Theorem 1给出Bayes风险解释——接受token风险w_i(1−p_i(u))，擦除风险λ_i，故Bayes最优动作为阈值形式c_i ≥ τ_i=1−λ_i/w_i时接受MAP token，否则擦除；部署时按组采用门限τ_{g(i)}，低置信度位置置为抽象擦除符号⊥（映射到mask token），交由Transformer型masked-token补全模型f_comp恢复为t̄，再经嵌入表与任务头f_task输出ŷ。Proposition 1通过插值路径与Cauchy–Schwarz给出任务损失退化的效用加权上界 |ΔL| ≤ Δ_max Σ_i w_i^sup·1{t̂_i≠t_i}，支撑效用加权误差计数这一发送端设计准则。门限标定：由于λ_i无闭式，Algorithm 3在验证集上用坐标搜索最小化任务损失得到{τ_g}。全流程为离线准备（效用剖面、分组、保护配置、门限标定、冻结的补全模型与任务头）+ 在线运行（分组→保护→软解码→门限→补全→推理）。
AI.result: 1) 任务精度：TONIC-Full(Grad)在AWGN/Rayleigh/Rician三种信道、匹配通信预算下均持续优于分离式传输、JPEG上界参考、像素域DeepJSCC及token域基线；AWGN精度最高，Rayleigh最难，Rician居中，说明增益不依赖单一传播条件。2) 预算鲁棒性：Rayleigh下在0.5B₀、B₀、2B₀三档预算上增益持续，低预算区间优势最明显（此时统一保护最浪费资源）。3) 消融：TONIC-UEP优于TONIC-UNI（不等保护单独有效），TONIC-GateComp（门限+补全）亦有效，完整组合最强，说明收益来自三模块协同而非单一机制。4) 梯度效用与oracle掩蔽效用差距很小，表明可部署的梯度效用已捕获足够的位置重要性结构。5) Token级诊断：TER随SNR下降且更强变体TER更低；WAR在极低SNR可能偏小（因大量擦除），随后先升后降，说明WAR是"被接受硬判决纯度"的诊断量而非精度的直接代理；准确率与TER非一一对应（错在关键位置影响更大），低WAR也不必然带来最高精度。6) 定性结果：效用热图显示token重要性空间高度非均匀，分组与保护机制可视化印证"把资源集中到任务关键位置"的设计直觉；去token化图像仅用于说明管线，不作为重建基准。
AI.conclusion: TONIC以token为通信对象，联合发送端"效用感知不等保护"与接收端"置信度门限+生成式补全"，在固定符号预算下同时控制"哪些token位置更强保护"与"残余不确定性如何处理"；理论侧给出任务损失退化的效用加权上界与效用感知Bayes最优门限（阈值形式），工程侧给出可部署的离线流程（效用剖面→分组→保护标定→门限坐标搜索），在线复杂度轻量。实验表明其在图像分类任务上一致优于分离式、DeepJSCC与token域基线，且梯度效用已接近oracle。局限：仅在无线图像传输+分类场景验证，视觉保真非目标，WAR/TER与精度非一一对应，端到端目标(7)仍未被精确求解（采用模块化代理）。未来工作：扩展到更丰富的多模态与多用户场景，并在动态无线条件下进一步收紧通信—token补全—下游决策三者的交互。

title: Toward AI VIS Co-Scientists: A General and End-to-End Agent Harness for Solving Complex Data Visualization Tasks
summary: The ability to inspect, interpret, and communicate complex data is crucial for virtually any scientific endeavor, but often requires significant expertise outside the core domain ranging from data management and analysis to visualization design and implementation. We present an end-to-end agentic harness that, based on only the data and a high level description of the tasks, independently designs custom visual analysis applications (VIS apps). This represents an important step towards a general AI co-scientist envisioned by many as an autonomous system that can autonomously execute long horizon tasks based on high-level directions. Our proposed VIS co-scientist is an essential component of this broader AI co-scientist vision: a harness that can autonomously analyze data and design visualization solutions using a collection of agents and specialized skills that coordinate exploratory analysis, plan, configure the environment, implement, validate the interface, and most importantly evaluate the overall task completion. Each stage produces document and instruction artifacts that guide downstream work and enable iterative refinement. We validate this approach on IEEE SciVis Contests spanning multiple science and engineering fields. These contests serve as ideal proving grounds because they encode real-world complexity: ambiguous requirements, diverse data modalities, design trade-offs, and task-driven validation. Given only the data and target tasks, our system autonomously produces functional single-page VIS Apps with verified linked-view behavior, highly customized to domain experts' specified tasks and needs.

AI.tldr: 提出了一个端到端的智能体（agentic）系统，能够仅根据数据和高层任务描述自动设计定制化的可视化分析应用，是通用AI合作科学家愿景的重要组成部分。该系统通过多智能体协作完成从探索分析到界面验证的全流程，已在IEEE SciVis竞赛中得到验证。
AI.motivation: 科学数据分析和可视化需要跨领域专业知识（数据管理、分析、可视化设计与实现），这些技能往往超出核心领域专家的能力范围，亟需自动化工具辅助。
AI.method: 采用多智能体（multi-agent）架构，协同协调探索性分析、任务规划、环境配置、实现、界面验证及整体任务完成度评估等阶段。每个阶段生成文档和指令制品（artifacts），指导下游工作并支持迭代优化。
AI.result: 在多个科学和工程领域的IEEE SciVis竞赛中进行验证，仅凭数据和目标任务即可自主生成具有验证链接视图行为的功能性单页VIS应用。
AI.conclusion: 本研究是迈向通用AI合作科学家（autonomous AI co-scientist）的重要一步，该系统能够基于高层指令自主执行长时域任务，可为领域专家生成高度定制化的单页可视化应用，并已通过IEEE SciVis竞赛验证了可行性。

title: FAME: Failure-Aware Mixture-of-Experts for Message-Level Log Anomaly Detection
summary: Production systems generate millions of log lines daily, yet most anomaly detectors operate at the session or window-level, flagging groups of lines rather than identifying the specific message responsible. This coarse granularity forces operators to inspect many routine lines per alert. Message-level detection offers finer granularity, but remains challenging. A single event template may correspond to both normal and anomalous messages, failures arise from heterogeneous subsystems, and line-level labeling at scale is impractical. Although large language models (LLMs) can reason over log semantics, applying them to every line is too costly for continuous monitoring. We present FAME (Failure-Aware Mixture-of-Experts), a label-efficient message-level mixture-of-experts framework that uses an LLM only once offline. We annotate at most K labeled lines per template to derive binary normal/anomaly indicators and representative examples. The LLM proposes a partition of templates into failure domains, and a certification step validates the proposal before training. FAME trains a lightweight router and domain experts that run on-premise and output anomaly predictions and failure-domain labels. On BGL, FAME achieves F1 = 98.16 at K = 100 reducing annotation effort by 76x and detects 86.3% of anomalies from unseen EventIDs. On Thunderbird, FAME reaches F1 = 99.95 with perfect recall.

AI.tldr: FAME是一个标签高效的消息级日志异常检测框架，通过离线一次性使用LLM进行模板级标注和失败域划分，然后训练轻量级路由器和领域专家模型进行在线推理，在保持高性能的同时大幅降低标注成本和推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有日志异常检测方法多在会话或窗口级别操作，粒度较粗，导致每次告警需人工检查大量常规日志。消息级检测虽更精细但面临挑战：同一事件模板可能对应正常和异常消息、故障源于异构子系统、大规模行级标注不切实际。直接应用LLM到每条日志进行连续监控成本过高。
AI.method: FAME采用混合专家架构，仅在离线阶段使用一次LLM进行：(1)对每个模板最多K条日志进行标注，生成二值正/异常指示器和代表性示例；(2)提出模板到失败域的分区方案；(3)通过认证步骤验证分区方案。然后训练轻量级路由器和领域专家模型，用于在线推理，输出异常预测和失败域标签。
AI.result: 在BGL数据集上，FAME在K=100时达到F1=98.16，标注工作量减少76倍，并能检测86.3%的未见EventID异常。在Thunderbird数据集上，FAME达到F1=99.95且召回率为100%。
AI.conclusion: FAME通过离线使用一次LLM，显著降低了标注成本，在BGL和Thunderbird两个数据集上验证了其有效性，实现了接近完美的检测性能，同时保持了标签高效性和可部署性。

title: SpecHop: Continuous Speculation for Accelerating Multi-Hop Retrieval Agents
summary: Large language models increasingly use external tools such as web search and document retrieval to solve information-intensive tasks. However, multi-hop tool use in complex tasks introduces substantial latency, since the model must repeatedly wait for tool observations before continuing. We study how to accelerate such trajectories without changing the final trajectory the model would have taken without acceleration, assuming access to faster but less reliable speculator tools. We develop a theoretical framework for lossless speculation in multi-hop tool-use settings, characterizing the optimal achievable latency gain. We propose SpecHop, a continuous speculation framework that maintains multiple speculative threads, verifies predicted observations asynchronously as target tool outputs arrive, commits correct branches, and rolls back incorrect ones. This preserves accuracy while reducing wall-clock latency. We show that SpecHop can approach oracle latency gains with enough active threads. Empirically, on retrieval-augmented multi-hop tasks, SpecHop closely matches theoretical predictions and reduces latency by up to 40\% in some settings. Code: https://github.com/mehrdadsaberi/spechop

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何在多跳工具调用场景中加速大型语言模型，同时保持最终结果不变。通过利用更快但可靠性较低的投机工具，提出了一种无损推测框架 SpecHop，可在检索增强的多跳任务中降低高达40%的延迟。
AI.motivation: 多跳工具使用（multi-hop tool use）在复杂信息密集型任务中引入大量延迟，因为模型需要反复等待工具返回结果才能继续执行。这种串行等待模式严重制约了系统的响应速度。
AI.method: 提出SpecHop连续推测框架，核心机制包括：维护多个推测线程、异步验证目标工具输出、提交正确分支、回滚错误分支。同时建立了损失推断的理论框架，刻画了最优可达延迟增益。
AI.result: 理论分析和实验结果表明：(1) SpecHop可逼近神谕(Oracle)延迟增益；(2) 在检索增强的多跳任务中，延迟降低可达40%；(3) 实验结果与理论预测高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: SpecHop通过连续推测和异步验证机制，在保持准确率的同时有效降低了多跳工具调用的延迟。该工作为理解推测系统的理论极限和设计实用系统提供了重要基础。

title: Beyond Single Slot: Joint Optimization for Multi-Slot Guaranteed Display Advertising
summary: Guaranteed display advertising is crucial for platform monetization, yet existing methods often operate under a single-slot assumption, limiting their ability to optimize allocation across multi-slot page views. In this paper, we propose a novel joint optimization framework for multi-slot GD allocation, addressing key challenges such as slot-level redundancy, contract imbalance, and exposure concentration. Our approach formulates the allocation as an offline bipartite matching problem with a contract roulette mechanism for slot exclusivity and Page View constraints for impression control, and incorporates a scalable allocation optimization algorithm for efficient large-scale deployment. Extensive online tests on the Meituan advertising platform demonstrate that our method significantly improves merchant ROI, platform revenue efficiency, and contract fulfillment robustness. Specifically, online A/B tests show a 28.99% increase in Average Revenue Per User under 70% traffic, and DID analysis further indicates improved contract stability, demonstrating the strong applicability and effectiveness of our framework in real-world advertising deployments.

AI.tldr: Proposes a joint optimization framework for multi-slot guaranteed display advertising allocation, solving slot-level redundancy, contract imbalance, and exposure concentration challenges through bipartite matching with contract roulette mechanism. Online experiments show 28.99% ARPU improvement.
AI.motivation: Existing guaranteed display advertising methods operate under a single-slot assumption, limiting their ability to optimize allocation across multi-slot page views. Key challenges include slot-level redundancy, contract imbalance, and exposure concentration.
AI.method: The approach formulates allocation as an offline bipartite matching problem with: (1) a contract roulette mechanism for slot exclusivity, (2) Page View constraints for impression control, and (3) a scalable allocation optimization algorithm for large-scale deployment.
AI.result: Online A/B tests on Meituan platform show 28.99% increase in Average Revenue Per User under 70% traffic. DID analysis demonstrates improved contract stability.
AI.conclusion: This framework significantly improves merchant ROI, platform revenue efficiency, and contract fulfillment robustness in real-world advertising deployments.

title: FLUID: From Ephemeral IDs to Multimodal Semantic Codes for Industrial-Scale Livestreaming Recommendation
summary: Modern recommender systems rely heavily on ID-based collaborative filtering: each item is represented by a unique ID embedding that accumulates collaborative signals from user interactions. Livestreaming recommendation, however, faces a unique challenge in this paradigm: a live room typically broadcasts for only tens of minutes, so its item ID remains poorly learned in a persistent cold-start state and ID-centric ranking models fail to generalize. We present FLUID, the first framework to fully retire the candidate-side item ID from a production-scale livestreaming ranker. FLUID couples a cross-domain multimodal encoder, jointly trained on short videos and livestreams to produce discrete hierarchical codes (LUCID), with a late-fusion, ID-free design that injects slice-level and room-level LUCID as independent tokens, stabilized by a staged warmup under online incremental training. Deployed on our industrial livestreaming recommenders with a cross-platform combined user base of over one billion globally, FLUID delivers significant online gains of +0.55% Quality Watch Duration, +2.05% Cold-Start Room Views, and +0.05% Active Hours.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FLUID框架，通过跨域多模态编码器生成离散层次编码(LUCID)替代传统物品ID，结合晚期融合设计解决直播推荐中物品ID冷启动问题。系统已在超10亿用户规模的生产环境中验证有效，冷启动和核心业务指标均显著提升。
AI.motivation: 直播推荐场景存在独特挑战：直播间通常仅播出数十分钟，其物品ID在持久性冷启动状态下难以充分学习，传统ID-centric排序模型泛化能力失效。
AI.method: FLUID框架核心包括：(1)跨域多模态编码器，在短视频和直播数据上联合训练生成离散层次编码(LUCID)；(2)晚期融合的ID-free设计，将切片级和房间级LUCID作为独立token注入模型；(3)在线增量训练下的分阶段预热策略实现稳定训练。
AI.result: 在全球超过10亿用户的跨平台直播推荐系统中，FLUID取得显著在线效果：质量观看时长+0.55%、冷启动房间曝光+2.05%、活跃时长+0.05%。
AI.conclusion: FLUID成功将物品ID从生产级直播推荐排序模型中移除，结合跨域多模态编码器（LUCID）和晚期融合设计，通过增量训练中的分阶段预热稳定模型。该系统在超过10亿用户的全球平台上部署，显著提升冷启动房间曝光和质量观看时长等核心指标。

title: From Parameters to Data: A Task-Parameter-Guided Fine-Tuning Pipeline for Efficient LLM Alignment
summary: Adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to specialized domains typically incurs high data and computational overhead. While prior efficiency efforts have largely treated data selection and parameter-efficient fine-tuning as isolated processes, our empirical analysis suggests they may be intrinsically coupled. We posit the Strong Map Hypothesis: a sparse subset of attention heads plays a dominant role in task-specific adaptation, acting as keys that unlock specific data patterns. Building on this observation, we propose From Parameters to Data (P2D), a unified framework that leverages these task-sensitive attention heads as a dual compass for both sample mining and structural pruning. To rigorously quantify the total pipeline cost, we introduce the Alignment Efficiency Ratio (AER) metric for both selection latency and training time. Mechanistically, P2D identifies critical heads via a lightweight proxy and uses them as a functional filter to curate high-affinity data, establishing a synergistic pipeline. Empirically, by updating merely 10% of attention heads on 10% of the data, P2D achieves an 8.3 pp performance gain over strong baselines and delivers a 7.0x end-to-end time speedup. These results validate that precise parameter-data synchronization eliminates redundancy, offering a new paradigm for efficient alignment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 P2D（From Parameters to Data）统一框架：把任务敏感注意力头当作"双罗盘"，同时驱动数据筛选与参数剪枝。三阶段——快速注意力头定位（轻量代理+复合矩阵 W_q W_k^T W_v 的 Wasserstein-1 距离打分）、参数引导的数据选择（仅在关键头上聚合注意力权重的 ICL 探针）、稀疏头适配（梯度掩码只更新 10% 头）；并提出 AER（Alignment Efficiency Ratio）把选择开销与训练时间一起纳入成本核算。在 10% 数据 + 10% 注意力头预算下，较强基线平均提升 8.3 pp、端到端最高 7.0×~8.63× 加速，同时缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: LLM 对齐到专业领域需要高昂的数据清洗与算力成本；此前工作把"数据选择"与"参数高效微调（PEFT）"当作两条彼此独立的技术路线，忽略了二者的内在耦合——为全参数微调优化的数据选择在稀疏参数配置下可能次优。作者通过经验分析提出"强映射假设（Strong Map Hypothesis）"：一小部分注意力头在任务适配中起主导作用，是打开特定数据模式的"钥匙"，且这类稀疏结构在训练极早期即已稳定出现。这促使范式从稠密对齐转向稀疏结构对齐，并需要一个能覆盖"选择开销+训练开销"的端到端效率指标（现有指标普遍忽略选择侧的前处理成本）。
AI.method: 三阶段流水线（Algorithm 1）。Stage I 快速头定位（FHI）：为避免全量微调成本，用 100 条随机样本、全批量训练 20 步构造轻量代理模型 M_T；对每个注意力头构造复合矩阵 W_comp^h = W_q^h W_k^{h⊤} W_v^h，将基座与代理模型的该矩阵 flatten 后做全局 Softmax（τ=0.1）转为分布 P_B、P_T，用 Wasserstein-1 距离得任务敏感度 s_h^PAD，取 top-ρ_P 组成任务敏感头集 H_T。该打分为"数据无关、无需前反向传播"，W1 对小参数漂移线性敏感（梯度类指标为二次/Fisher 抑制），实测 ~30 s（7B）至 ~100 s（32B），比梯度式打分快 20× 以上。Stage II 参数引导数据选择（P2D†）：以 ICL 探针（demo 集+disjoint query 集，5-shot 拼接）计算基础任务得分 s，再仅在 H_T 上聚合注意力权重得到每个样本的结构权重 w（按 token 长度归一化），迭代 T 轮累积 v_i=s·w，按被抽中次数取均值得到 final score，排序取 top-ρ_D 得 D_T。Stage III 稀疏头适配（P2D‡）：冻结除 H_T 对应 {W_q,W_k,W_v} 外全部参数，用指示函数掩码梯度 ∇←m_h·∇，以标准负对数似然训练。AER 指标：AER(f)=t_f/t_FFT，其中 t_f=选择时间 t(f_ds,ρ_D)（含代理训练与打分等全部前处理）+适配时间 t(f_ft,ρ_P,D_T)，AER<1 表示真实端到端加速。训练用 LLaMA-Factory + DeepSpeed ZeRO-2、8×A100、AdamW、lr 2e-5、warmup+cosine、3 epoch、FP16、3 个随机种子（42/43/44）取平均。
AI.result: 1）主结果（GSM8K / DialogSum / BioInstruct，Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen3-8B、Llama3-8B，10% 数据 + 10% 头）：完整 P2D 在三模型三任务上均最优，例：GSM8K 82.56/84.78/69.12，DialogSum 46.45/43.23/42.45，BioInstruct 32.78/32.89/32.56；并超过"全量数据+全参数"基线（GSM8K 81.55/84.89/68.63 等）。2）效率（Table 2/23）：P2D†+P2D‡ 的 AER 最低（GSM8K 0.32、DialogSum 0.38、BioInstruct 0.25），选择开销仅 ~0.15/0.21/0.08（对比 Nuggets 1.46、IFD 0.63），相对 Nuggets 全参加速 5.97×/8.63×/6.48×；加速拆解为参数稀疏 ~1.72× 与数据稀疏 ~2.22× 复合。3）ZeRO-2 通信核算：可训练参数仅 ~0.94%，每步每 GPU 同步流量从 ~30.4 GB 降至 ~0.30 GB（约 100×），且随 GPU 数增大优势更明显（AER 0.62→0.54、换 H200 0.54→0.48）。4）规模扩展（Qwen2.5 1.5B→32B）：P2D‡ 在所有尺度优于 Full SFT 与 LoRA，增益随规模扩大（32B：GSM 90.23 vs 88.94、Bio 47.89 vs 45.78），印证"强映射随参数量更集中"。5）消融：ρ_D 在 GSM8K 上 10% 即稳健（域任务需更多数据）；ρ_P 最优点在 10%–30%。6）公平性：LoRA rank 搜索 r∈{32,64,128,256}（可训练 0.24%–1.90%）在所有秩上均落后 P2D 3–4 pp。7）机制验证："锁-钥匙"交叉消融显示仅 P2D 数据×P2D 头最优（P2D 数据+随机头 78.82→67.13；P2D 头+随机数据 72.32；DW 数据+P2D 头 75.84）；FHI 代理仅 100 样本/20 步即足够（50 步几乎无增益，DialogSum 甚至回退），证明"结构敏感性稳定早于任务精度"；热图显示跨任务热点空间分离但存在共享语言核心；所选 10% 子集 PPL 更低但平均长度与全量相当（DialogSum 227.0→231.5 token），排除长度偏置。8）灾难性遗忘：UltraChat 10% 数据上，Full SFT 使 MMLU 74.23→56.34、ARC-C 88.14→61.89，P2D 保持 67.45 / 78.23。9）稳定性：跨种子 top-10% 头重叠 ~90.7%（79/784），所选 10% 数据 Jaccard ~93.1%。10）打分指标对比（Appendix E）：余弦相似度崩至 GSM8K 63.28，梯度式 76.48（耗时 ~10 min），W1 达 78.82（~30 s），且 W1 优势随规模扩大（32B Bio +2.00 pp）。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心贡献是把"数据选择"与"参数高效微调"统一到同一结构信号之下，并给出可度量的端到端效率口径（AER）。结论要点：(1) 强映射假设获得实证支持——下游能力非均匀分布，而是稀疏映射到任务特异的注意力头子网络，且随模型规模增大愈发集中；(2) 稀疏头适配优于 LoRA/LoFiT/全参 SFT，差距源于结构拓扑差异而非参数容量，且能显著缓解灾难性遗忘；(3) 参数-数据的"锁-钥匙"耦合是必要的，任一方向单独替换都会大幅退化，说明 P2D 不是简单拼装已有组件；(4) 效率增益主要来自可训练参数稀疏带来的分布式通信/显存缩减，而非单纯数据缩减。局限（作者自述）：仅更新注意力头、MLP 全冻结，难以注入预训练中不存在的新事实（需引入少量 MLP 组件的混合方案）；FHI 依赖 100 样本玩具训练，可能漏掉需长训练才显现的头（尤其高度领域偏移任务）；7.0× 加速绑定 ZeRO-2 + 8×A100 设定，跨优化器/硬件需再验证；ICL 打分仍继承对示例选择的敏感性（靠跨 query 重采样缓解而非消除）；仅在 SFT 场景验证，推广到 RLHF/DPO 及 P2D-LoRA 混合留作未来工作。

title: Planning in the LLM Era: Building for Reliability and Efficiency
summary: Growing attention to intelligent agents has put a spotlight on one of their central capabilities: planning. Early attempts to leverage large language models (LLMs) for planning relied on single-shot plan generation, followed by hybrid approaches that coupled LLMs with limited external search. These methods, unsound and incomplete by their very nature, often require substantial resources without yielding better solutions on unseen problems. As the limitations of LLMs become clearer, recent work has shifted toward using them at solution construction time -- generating symbolic solvers for a family of problems that can be verified and then used efficiently at inference time. This trend reflects the growing need for agents that are both reliable and resource-efficient. It also offers a path towards generating maintainable planners with minimal dependence on language models at inference time. In this paper, we argue that this shift reflects a broader realignment of the planning field in the LLM era. We examine three major categories of planner-generation methods, discuss their current limitations, and outline research steps towards a more reliable and efficient LLM-based generation of planners.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文，审视LLM时代智能体规划领域的发展趋势。作者追溯了从单阶段生成到混合搜索再到符号求解器生成的演进路径，论证当前规划研究正从"推理时依赖LLM"向"构建时生成符号求解器"范式转变，并系统分析了三类规划器生成方法的现状与局限，为未来可靠、高效的LLM规划研究指明方向。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体规划能力的可靠性与资源效率问题日益突出。早期方法（单阶段生成和混合搜索）存在本质缺陷：不健全且不完备，需要大量资源却无法在未见问题上获得更优解。这促使学界重新审视规划方法的根本架构。
AI.method: 论文采用分类综述方法，将现有LLM规划方法划分为三大类别进行系统梳理，分析各方法的核心局限：单阶段生成方法存在不健全/不完备性；混合方法资源消耗大；符号求解器生成方法具有可验证性和推理时高效性的优势。
AI.result: 论文明确了规划领域在LLM时代的新方向：将LLM应用于解决方案构建阶段，生成可验证的符号求解器，而非在推理时持续依赖LLM。这一转变不仅提高了可靠性与资源效率，还为生成可维护的规划器提供了可行路径。
AI.conclusion: 本文论证了LLM时代规划领域正经历根本性范式转变——从在推理时依赖LLM逐步生成计划，转向在构建时生成可验证的符号求解器。三类规划器生成方法各有局限，作者呼吁学界推进更可靠、高效的LLM规划器生成研究。核心洞见：推理时对语言模型的依赖应最小化，以实现可维护的资源高效规划系统。

title: Hallucination as Commitment Failure: Larger LLMs Misfire Despite Knowing the Answer
summary: Hallucination is often viewed as a direct consequence of missing knowledge: a model answers incorrectly when the correct answer is absent from its generation-time distribution, and correctly when it is present. We test this assumption by introducing a semantic notion of answer availability that aggregates token-level variants expressing the same answer concept, and asks whether the correct concept is already available at the moment the model commits to an answer. Across Qwen and Llama models from 0.8B to 72B in both Instruct and Base variants, 16-47% of Instruct hallucinations occur with substantial probability mass already on the correct concept, and the rate rises monotonically with scale. Comparing such failures against correct generations with matched semantic support, the distinguishing factor is not whether the correct concept is represented, but how its probability is distributed: correct generations concentrate mass on a single surface form, hallucinations disperse it across alternatives. The same sharpening asymmetry extends across multi-token generation and is detectable in pre-generation hidden states. Together, these results identify a single mechanism: instruction tuning sharpens answer commitment with scale, making helpfulness and confident hallucination two consequences of the same underlying disposition.

AI.tldr: 本研究挑战了"幻觉因正确知识缺失而发生"的传统假设。通过引入语义答案可用性概念，发现16-47%的指令微调模型幻觉发生在正确答案概念已有显著概率的情况下，且该比例随模型规模单调增加。正确生成与幻觉的区别不在于正确答案是否被表征，而在于概率分布方式：正确生成将概率集中于单一表面形式，幻觉则分散于多个替代选项。这一"锐化不对称性"贯穿多token生成全程，并可从生成前的隐藏状态中检测到。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为幻觉是知识缺失的直接后果：当正确答案不在模型的生成分布中时模型给出错误答案，当答案存在时则正确。本研究旨在通过引入语义层面的答案可用性概念，系统验证这一假设是否成立。
AI.method: 提出语义答案可用性的形式化定义，将表达相同答案概念的token级变体进行聚合；分析Qwen和Llama 0.8B至72B全系列模型（Instruct和Base两种变体）在模型做出回答承诺的时刻，检验正确答案概念是否已在概率分布中。进一步对比正确生成与幻觉样本的概率分布特征差异。
AI.result: 在Instruct模型中，16-47%的幻觉发生在正确答案概念已有显著概率质量的情况下，且该比例随模型规模单调上升。对比语义支持度相同的正确生成与幻觉样本，发现二者的区分因素并非正确答案概念是否存在，而是概率如何分布：正确生成将概率集中于单一表面形式，幻觉则将概率分散至多个替代选项。
AI.conclusion: 指令微调（instruction tuning）随模型规模增强了答案承诺的"锐化"能力，助长性和自信性幻觉源于同一底层机制。这一发现表明幻觉可能部分源于模型过度自信地将概率分配给错误表面形式，而非简单的知识缺失。

title: AutoMCU: Feasibility-First MCU Neural Network Customization via LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Deploying neural networks on microcontroller units (MCUs) is critical for edge intelligence but remains challenging due to tight memory, storage, and computation constraints. Existing approaches, such as model compression and hardware-aware neural architecture search (HW-NAS), often depend on proxy metrics, incur high search cost, and do not fully bridge the gap between architecture design and verified deployment. This paper presents AutoMCU, a feasibility-first large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent system for automated neural network customization under MCU constraints. Given natural-language task requirements and hardware specifications, AutoMCU iteratively generates structured architecture candidates, filters infeasible designs through vendor toolchain feedback before training, evaluates feasible models under a controlled protocol, and verifies deployability through backend-grounded deployment analysis. AutoMCU includes two key mechanisms: 1) hardware-in-the-loop architecture generation for early elimination of undeployable candidates under RAM and Flash constraints, and 2) state-isolated multi-agent scheduling for stable coordination of proposal, training, evaluation, and deployment stages. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 under strict MCU constraints show that AutoMCU achieves competitive accuracy while reducing customization time to about 1--2 hours, compared with hundreds of GPU hours for representative MCU-oriented HW-NAS baselines. Comparisons with ColabNAS and the LLM-based NAS method GENIUS on NAS-Bench-201 further demonstrate the effectiveness and stability of AutoMCU. Real-device deployments on multiple STM32 microcontrollers validate its practical applicability to MCU-scale edge intelligence.

AI.tldr: AutoMCU 是一个"可行性优先"的 LLM 多智能体系统，用自然语言任务需求 + 硬件约束驱动，自动生成结构化网络架构候选，先经厂商工具链（STM32Cube.AI）做 RAM/Flash 与算子兼容性硬过滤，再进入受控训练，最终闭环迭代并输出可部署 C 代码。在 CIFAR-10/100 上，它把定制时间从代表性 MCU HW-NAS 基线（μNAS）的数百 GPU 小时降到约 1–2 小时，精度与 μNAS 相当或更高（如 CIFAR-100 严格约束下 58.70% vs 58.82%，且 μNAS 违反约束），在 NAS-Bench-201 上搜索精度与稳定性均优于 LLM-NAS 方法 GENIUS，并在 STM32F407VET6 与 STM32H723ZGT6 真机上完成部署验证。
AI.motivation: MCU 上的神经网络部署受限于极紧的片上 RAM、非易失 Flash 与算力，但现有路线存在三点根本不足：(1) 模型压缩/手工轻量化（MobileNet、ShuffleNet、剪枝量化蒸馏）面向固定或同质硬件，无法适配高度碎片化的 MCU 资源约束，且多为训练后处理，难以与硬件感知评估和部署工具链打通；(2) NAS/HW-NAS（μNAS、ColabNAS 等）依赖参数量、MACs、延迟等代理指标或加权标量化多目标优化，无法刻画"后端可部署性"，训练后才发现算子不支持、内存分配超限或转换失败，造成大量算力浪费（μNAS 需数百 GPU 小时）；(3) LLM 辅助架构生成方法（如 GENIUS）面向常规深度学习场景，未显式建模 Flash/SRAM 硬预算、算子支持与后端转换行为，且未与部署后端闭环。此外，架构搜索、训练与部署验证长期割裂，需要工程师在设计、训练、模型转换、硬件验证间反复手工迭代（Fig.1 的试错流程），开发成本高。因此需要一个以"真实后端验证的可部署性"为第一优先信号、把搜索与部署验证纳入同一闭环的自动化定制流程。
AI.method:
系统由一个 Supervisor 组件 + 三个任务模块构成：Proposal Agent（生成/精炼候选结构）、Training Agent（受控训练）、Evaluation and Conversion Agent（后端可行性验证与部署产物生成），形成"propose–screen–train–evaluate"闭环。核心机制有二：
(1) 硬件在环架构生成 HAG。候选被形式化为结构化规范 a=(B,H)，B=[l_1..l_n] 为骨干层序列，l_i=(t_i,θ_i)，t_i 取自预定义原子模块集合（conv、depthwise、downsample、pointwise、ghost、bottleneck 等），θ_i 给出通道、核、步幅、填充、扩张比等配置；通用模型构建器解析该规范实例化为可执行网络，仅当 schema 合法且层间张量维度一致才算"可构造"。实例化后立即调用厂商工具链（STM32Cube.AI）测得 RAM、Flash 与算子兼容性，违反硬约束者立即淘汰，不进入训练。历史仓库记录 r_j=(id_j,a_j,p_j,m_j)（含架构规范、精度、RAM、Flash），供 LLM 基于结构化反馈做定向精炼。Proposal Agent 为可插拔模块，可替换为随机搜索或启发式规则（用于消融）。
(2) 多智能体调度与交互机制 MSIM。Supervisor 解析用户请求、分解子任务、分发并决定终止；各 Agent 内部状态隔离，只接收与自身任务相关的信息，交互推理过程、工具调用细节与内部决策轨迹不跨 Agent 共享，仅以结构化摘要（任务状态+关键结果）回传。相比共享上下文范式，这避免了上下文膨胀、token 消耗激增与角色越权导致的不稳定。
训练侧采用"判别性受控训练"：统一数据划分、预处理、优化器与评估指标，固定 epoch 预算 + 验证集停滞早停，目标是比较而非极致优化每个候选，从而在有限成本下提供可比反馈，并将任务性能与硬件可行性解耦。部署侧用后端报告 M(a;C)=(RAM(a),Flash(a),status(a)) 作为实现级（而非代理）反馈，输出包含精度、RAM、Flash、算子兼容性状态与部署产物路径的报告，既做最终接受判定也作下一轮提案的精炼依据。历史仓库按 R^(k+1)=R^(k)∪{(a,P(a;D,T),M(a;C))} 迭代更新，循环在满足用户要求或达到最大迭代预算时终止。
AI.result:
实验环境为 AMD EPYC 7642 + RTX 3090 24GB，LLM 默认为 DeepSeek-V3.2 API（温度固定 0，另测 MiMo-V2-Flash、Qwen-Plus），数据集为原生 32×32 的 CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100（并扩展 MNIST、FashionMNIST），所有硬件指标均由 STM32Cube.AI 实测。
(1) MCU 定向基线对比（Table I）：宽松约束（RAM≤1024KB、Flash≤1024KB）下 AutoMCU(DeepSeek) 达 89.31±0.16%（CIFAR-10）、61.63±0.50%（CIFAR-100），RAM 218.81KB / Flash 848.97KB，耗时 1.58±1.07 GPU 小时、成本 0.45 美元；μNAS 精度相当（89.75%）但需 257.48 GPU 小时、53.35 美元且 RAM 1159.99KB 违反约束，ColabNAS 仅 74.77%。MobileNetV2/ShuffleNetV2/SqueezeNet/MCUNet-in2/MnasNet/FairNAS-C 的 Flash 高达 2197–12094KB，即使 MCUNet 也超 1MB 预算两倍以上。严格约束（RAM≤256KB、Flash≤512KB）下 AutoMCU 达 87.62±0.52%（CIFAR-10）、58.70±0.71%（CIFAR-100），μNAS（87.88%）的 RAM/Flash（580.92/872.34KB）双超限，ColabNAS 降至 56.71%/41.26%。
(2) 超低资源（Table II）：RAM/Flash=64/64KB 时 CIFAR-10 76.36%、MNIST 99.23%、FashionMNIST 91.28%；128/256KB 时分别达 84.12%、99.48%、92.72%，单次定制仅约 0.3–0.5 GPU 小时、0.1–0.2M token。
(3) NAS-Bench-201 对比 GENIUS（Table III，同预算 10 次运行×每次 10 个架构）：CIFAR-10 验证/测试 90.89/93.74 vs 90.82/93.73；CIFAR-100 72.32/72.24 vs 71.37/71.30；ImageNet16-120 45.07/45.19 vs 44.63/44.51，且方差显著更小（ImageNet16-120 验证 std 由 2.28 降至 0.85，测试 std 由 2.49 降至 0.95）。
(4) 消融（Table IV，严格约束 CIFAR-10）：完整系统 87.62% 且失败率 0%、token 0.46M；w/o MSIM 精度相当但失败率 50%、token 翻倍至 0.99M；w/o HAG（随机搜索）降至 82.89±2.81%、RAM/Flash 方差更大、耗时升至 3.81 GPU 小时；Baseline（共享上下文+随机搜索）仅 81.06±3.72%、失败率 60%、token 1.92M。
(5) 真机部署（Table V）：STM32F407VET6（Cortex-M4 168MHz，192KB RAM/512KB Flash）上 MNIST 99.36%、FashionMNIST 93.42%、CIFAR-10 86.39%、CIFAR-100 58.05%；STM32H723ZGT6（Cortex-M7 550MHz，564KB RAM/1MB Flash）上分别 99.37%、93.94%、88.99%、61.66%，全部模型成功编译并在设备上运行。
AI.conclusion:
AutoMCU 通过把厂商部署工具链（STM32Cube.AI）直接嵌入搜索闭环，把 MCU 模型定制从"代理指标驱动的 HW-NAS"转为"后端验证的可行性优先搜索"：硬件可行性作为训练前的硬约束被强制执行，HAG 机制用结构化可构造规范 + 提前过滤消除不可部署候选，MSIM 机制用集中式监督与状态隔离保证长程自动化稳定、token 效率高。实验表明它在严格 MCU 约束下取得与 μNAS 相当甚至更高的精度（CIFAR-100 上 61.63% vs 60.26%），同时把定制时间从数百 GPU 小时压缩到约 1–2 小时、搜索成本降至 1 美元以内；在 NAS-Bench-201 上优于 GENIUS 且稳定性更佳；消融验证 HAG 与 MSIM 缺一不可；多款 STM32 真机部署证明其实用性。
需注意的局限与可讨论点：① 在 CIFAR-10 严格约束下精度略低于 μNAS（87.62% vs 87.88%），μNAS 通过多目标标量化而非硬过滤，可能"违规"但精度略高；② 消融中异常终止的运行被剔除统计，仅单独报告失败率，这在方法论上对不稳定变体有偏袒，需谨慎解读其均值；③ 后端仅验证 STM32Cube.AI/STM32 平台，跨后端（其他 MCU 厂商、TFLite Micro、嵌入式推理框架）的通用性尚未实证；④ 任务范围仅限图像分类，尚未覆盖 TinyML 语音/NLP 任务；⑤ 成本与时间仅以 GPU 小时和 token 计，未纳入人工固件集成与烧录开销；⑥ 基线轻量模型的 Flash 数据（数千至上万 KB）基于 fp32，与 AutoMCU 报告口径的可比性需进一步澄清。
未来工作：扩展到更广泛的 TinyML 负载、接入更多异构部署后端与开源嵌入式推理框架、结合更强的架构搜索与硬件建模方法提升定制质量与跨平台适应性。

title: VeriScale: Adversarial Test-Suite Scaling for Verifiable Code Generation
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for software engineering, constructing high-quality benchmarks is crucial for evaluating not just the functional correctness, but also the formal verifiability of generated code. However, existing benchmarks are limited by the quantity and quality of positive and negative test cases, leading to an overestimation of model capabilities in generating specifications and implementations. To address this, we propose VeriScale, a novel framework driven by the adversarial implementations. It consists of two stages: test-suite expansion to construct diverse and challenging test cases, and test-suite reduction to distill them into compact yet discriminative suites. While VeriScale is general, we instantiate it on Verina to construct VerinaPlus, which expands the original test suites by over 83$\times$, and VerinaLite, a lightweight 14$\times$ variant. Our experiments across eight state-of-the-art LLMs demonstrate that VerinaPlus exposes substantial model weaknesses hidden by the original benchmark, evidenced by sharp score drops on both SpecGen and CodeGen tasks, whereas VerinaLite maintains this discriminative power at a fraction of the evaluation cost. The enhanced benchmarks and source code are publicly available at https://github.com/XiaoyangLiu-sjtu/VeriScale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VeriScale框架，通过对抗式测试用例生成和蒸馏技术，显著提升了代码生成基准测试的质量。VerinaPlus扩展83倍测试用例揭示了LLM的隐藏弱点，VerinaLite则在保持区分能力的同时将评估成本降至原来的1/14。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试受限于测试用例的数量和质量，导致对LLM在规格生成和代码实现方面的能力产生过高估计，无法准确评估模型的实际水平。
AI.method: 提出了VeriScale框架，采用对抗式实现驱动的方法，包含两个阶段：(1)测试套件扩展阶段，构建多样化和具有挑战性的测试用例；(2)测试套件缩减阶段，蒸馏出紧凑且具有区分性的测试集。在Verina基准上实例化该框架，生成了VerinaPlus（原始测试套件扩展83倍）和VerinaLite（14倍轻量级变体）。对8个最先进的LLM进行了实验评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明VerinaPlus能够暴露原始基准测试中被掩盖的模型弱点，在SpecGen和CodeGen任务上均出现显著分数下降；VerinaLite在大幅降低评估成本的同时保持了相同的区分能力。
AI.conclusion: VeriScale框架成功提升了代码生成基准测试的质量；VerinaPlus和VerinaLite两种变体分别在全面性和效率上展现出优势，为LLM评估提供了更具挑战性的测试平台。

title: LatentOmni: Rethinking Omni-Modal Understanding via Unified Audio-Visual Latent Reasoning
summary: Joint audio-visual reasoning is essential for omnimodal understanding, yet current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) still struggle when reasoning requires fine-grained evidence from both modalities. A central limitation is that explicit text-based chain-of-thought (CoT) compresses continuous audio-visual signals into discrete tokens, weakening temporal grounding and shifting intermediate reasoning toward language priors. We argue that a unified latent space is a better medium for such reasoning because it preserves dense sensory information while remaining compatible with autoregressive generation. Based on this insight, we propose \textbf{LatentOmni}, a cross-modal reasoning framework that interleaves textual reasoning with audio-visual latent states. LatentOmni introduces feature-level supervision to align latent reasoning states with task-relevant sensory features and uses Omni-Sync Position Embedding (OSPE) to maintain temporal consistency between latent audio and visual states. We further construct \textbf{LatentOmni-Instruct-35K}, a dataset of audio-visual interleaved reasoning trajectories for supervising latent-space reasoning. Comprehensive evaluation across multiple audio-visual reasoning benchmarks demonstrates that LatentOmni achieves the best performance among the evaluated open-source models and consistently outperforms the Explicit Text CoT baseline, supporting latent-space joint reasoning as a promising path toward stronger omnimodal understanding.

AI.tldr: 论文提出LatentOmni框架，利用统一潜在空间进行音频-视觉联合推理，避免显式文本链式思维对连续信号的压缩和信息损耗，通过特征级监督和OSPE时序嵌入保持模态一致性，在开源模型中实现最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs在需要细粒度跨模态证据的推理任务中表现不佳；显式文本链式思维（CoT）将连续音视频信号压缩为离散token，削弱了时序定位能力，并将中间推理偏向语言先验。
AI.method: 1) 提出LatentOmni跨模态推理框架，在文本推理中交织音频-视觉潜在状态；2) 引入特征级监督对齐潜在推理状态与任务相关感官特征；3) 设计OSPE（Omni-Sync Position Embedding）维持音频与视觉潜在状态间的时序一致性；4) 构建LatentOmni-Instruct-35K数据集用于潜在空间推理监督。
AI.result: 在多个音频-视觉推理基准测试中达到开源模型最佳性能，持续优于Explicit Text CoT基线方法。
AI.conclusion: Latent-space joint reasoning是一个有前景的方向，可实现更强的全模态理解能力；LatentOmni在开源模型中取得最佳性能，验证了该方法的有效性。

title: Objective-Induced Bias and Search Dynamics in Multiobjective Unsupervised Feature Selection
summary: Unsupervised feature selection is commonly formulated as a multiobjective optimisation problem that jointly optimises subset quality and subset size. Yet the behaviour of this formulation depends critically on the choice of evaluation objective, the direction of subset-size regularisation, and the initialisation strategy. We study these factors in a controlled setting using a synthetic dataset with known informative, redundant, and irrelevant feature types. Six formulations are compared by combining three evaluation objectives: accuracy, silhouette score, and PCA reconstruction loss with subset-size minimisation or maximisation. The results show that formulation strongly affects both search dynamics and the quality of the resulting Pareto front. Silhouette-based formulations exhibit a strong bias toward trivial low-cardinality solutions and remain weak proxies for predictive performance. In contrast, the proposed PCA loss objective produces compact subsets with test accuracy comparable to subsets obtained by directly optimising supervised accuracy. Overall, the study shows that objective design is central to effective multiobjective unsupervised feature selection.

AI.tldr: 本文在合成数据上系统研究了无监督特征选择的多目标建模形式，比较三种评估目标（分类准确率、轮廓系数、作者新提出的PCA重构损失）×两种子集规模正则方向（最小化/最大化）×三种初始化策略共六种MOFS形式。结论：轮廓系数存在强烈的低基数平凡解偏置，是预测性能的弱代理；新提出的PCA重构损失作为无监督目标能产出紧凑且测试精度接近直接优化监督准确率的子集；最优形式为"目标最小化 + 规模最小化 + 固定基数初始化"。
AI.motivation: 无监督特征选择（UFS）常被形式化为"同时优化子集质量与子集规模"的多目标问题，但该形式化高度依赖三个未被充分研究的设计选择：(1) 评估目标 f1 的选取（分类准确率、轮廓系数、重构误差等）；(2) 子集规模正则项 f2 的方向（最小化还是最大化）；(3) 种群初始化的基数分布。这些选择决定在有限评估预算下哪些 Pareto 前沿区域可达。此外，真实数据缺乏特征结构真值，Pareto 前沿通常只能通过目标值解读，难以判断所选子集是否保留了信息量、是否引入冗余与噪声特征，因此需要一个可控的、带已知特征分类体系（信息特征、线性/非线性冗余特征、噪声特征）的实验框架来剥离混杂因素。
AI.method: 问题形式化：在二进制决策空间 {0,1}^d 上同时最小化 (f1(X_x), f2(x))，f1 为评估目标，f2 为子集基数（最小化时 f2=|x|，最大化时 f2=-|x|）。三种 f1：(a) 轮廓目标——对过滤后子集做 k-means（k 在候选范围内按轮廓值择取），取负轮廓值的均值作为待最小化目标；(b) 准确率目标——随机森林分类准确率取负（作为监督基线）；(c) 新提出的 PCA 重构损失目标——先用全量 X 做 PCA 得前 k 主成分目标矩阵 Z（固定为预处理），再用多元线性回归从子集 X_x 预测 Z，最小化 MSE 1/n·Σ||Z_i - Ẑ_i||²；该目标以"集体信息"评估子集，故与已选特征高度相关的冗余特征贡献可忽略，从而显式处理冗余。优化器为 SMS-EMOA，种群 50、迭代 50 代，决策空间 {0,1}^d；三种初始化：二元随机采样（伯努利阈值 p）、分段采样（p∈{0.25,0.5,0.75} 三等分种群）、固定基数采样（如 k=1）。数据集：合成三分类问题，特征类型含信息特征（make_classification 加噪声与随机标签翻转）、线性冗余、非线性冗余、高斯噪声、结构化噪声、Sweep（逐步加噪版本），并记录每个衍生特征的"谱系"（由哪些信息特征生成）。评估：仅在训练集上优化，最终 Pareto 解在留出测试集上用随机森林准确率评估；用层次聚类（dendrogram）将 Pareto 解按所选特征分组成 C1–C4 并映射到前沿；统计检验为 30 个随机种子 × 5 个合成数据集，按超体积（accuracy–size 投影空间）排名，Friedman–Nemenyi 事后检验并做 Holm 校正（α=0.01）。
AI.result: (1) 搜索动力学：采用"最小化规模 + 最大化准确率"时得到分布良好的 Pareto 前沿；初始化策略影响显著——由于 RF 评估代价高、组合空间巨大，在预算内难以跨越高低基数区间，故以 k=1 的极低基数初始化更优（低基数起点更接近信息特征集，精度目标的选择压力会驱动种群向更大子集扩张）；"规模最小化 + 轮廓最大化"则因两者同向偏好低基数而使搜索坍缩到原点的平凡解。(2) 特征组成：轮廓目标即便配以规模最大化并正确控制了基数偏置，仍倾向选中冗余甚至无关特征（如 23、26、29），且"朴素真值"被其前沿支配却无一支配解带来更高分类准确率，说明轮廓是分类性能的弱代理。(3) PCA 损失 + 规模最小化：C1–C3 成功保留大部分信息特征（Feature 1 虽未直接选中，但其派生特征 80 被选中，信息得以保存；Feature 6 的信息在部分解中重复出现说明仍有冗余），朴素真值与若干解接近，表明能有效逼近近优子集；C4 过度稀疏、精度较低。(4) 形式化对比：直接优化准确率最强；PCA 损失无监督方案解与之接近且显著优于轮廓系方案；最优配置为"准确率最大化/PCA 损失 + 规模最小化 + 固定基数初始化"；轮廓系方法一致性地表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: 目标函数设计是多目标无监督特征选择的核心。聚类质量类目标（轮廓系数）天然偏向低基数平凡子集，应与"规模最大化"配对但仍不是分类性能的好代理；基于重构的目标（本文提出的 PCA 重构损失）能提供更稳定的信号，无需标签且计算更廉价，可产出与直接优化监督准确率相当的紧凑子集。局限与展望：结论仅基于合成数据（含已知特征分类体系与谱系追踪的合成生成流程为本研究定制），真实数据集上的验证是必要的下一步；同时可探索更多无监督目标，以及用非线性重构模型（如神经网络）刻画更复杂的潜在表示，以进一步提升性能。

title: Format-Constraint Coupling in Knowledge Graph Construction from Statistical Tables
comment: 8 pages main body, 18 pages appendices. Submitted to EMNLP 2026 via ACL Rolling Review (ARR). Corresponding author: Yuxiang Feng (yxfeng@scut.edu.cn). Code and data available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/sge_lightrag-BE19
summary: An extraction schema should not reduce knowledge graph fidelity. On statistical CSV, however, it can. We study country-by-year time-series matrices, a common layout on open-data portals. In this setting, serialization format and schema constraints interact super-additively. Their joint effect exceeds the sum of independent effects by up to +1.180 (2x2 factorial, 6 datasets). Bootstrap 95% CIs are strictly positive on 4/6 datasets, with strongest evidence on wide Type-II matrices. More critically, a schema applied to a mismatched format can trigger catastrophic mismatch. Fact coverage falls below the unconstrained baseline on 4/6 datasets through entity inflation or extraction refusal. We call this observed pattern format-constraint coupling. Probing and token ablation support a surface-form anchoring explanation centred on column-name references. Controlled variants across format-schema pairings, GraphRAG hosts, and LLM families show the same direction within the measured scope; one LLM family shows only partial activation. The observation also has a diagnostic consequence. Three standard retrieval modes largely mask construction quality (delta <= 1pp), whereas direct graph access exposes gaps up to +47.6pp (p < 0.0001). To support fidelity-aware evaluation, we release CSVFidelity-Bench. It contains 15 datasets, 11 Type-II matrices, 4 Type-III tables, and 1,892 Gold Standard facts across 6 domains.

AI.tldr: Identifies "format-constraint coupling" as a super-additive interaction between CSV serialization format and schema constraints that degrades KG fidelity on statistical data; surface-form anchoring via column-name references is the mechanism; proposes direct graph access as diagnostic tool; releases CSVFidelity-Bench benchmark.
AI.motivation: Schema extraction on statistical CSV data reduces knowledge graph fidelity through an interaction effect between serialization format and schema constraints ("format-constraint coupling"), with catastrophic mismatch when schema meets mismatched format.
AI.method: 2x2 factorial design across serialization format and schema constraints; bootstrap 95% CIs; controlled ablation on format-schema pairings, GraphRAG hosts, and LLM families; probing and token ablation experiments.
AI.result: Format-constraint coupling exceeds additive effects by up to +1.180 (2x2 factorial, 6 datasets); fact coverage drops below baseline on 4/6 datasets via entity inflation or extraction refusal; surface-form anchoring (column-name references) identified as mechanism; direct graph access exposes quality gaps up to +47.6pp (p<0.0001) while standard retrieval modes mask gaps (delta<=1pp).
AI.conclusion: Release of CSVFidelity-Bench (15 datasets, 1,892 Gold Standard facts) to support fidelity-aware evaluation; direct graph access reveals gaps up to +47.6pp whereas standard retrieval modes mask construction quality.

title: SynAE: A Framework for Measuring the Quality of Synthetic Data for Tool-Calling Agent Evaluations
summary: Today, tool-calling agents are commonly evaluated or tested on static datasets of execution traces, including input commands, agent responses, and associated tool calls. However, internal production datasets are often insufficient or unusable for testing; for example, they may contain sensitive or proprietary data, or they may be too sparse to support comprehensive testing (especially pre-deployment). In these settings, practitioners are increasingly replacing or augmenting real datasets with synthetic ones for evaluation purposes. A key challenge is quantifying the relation between these synthetic datasets and the real data. We introduce SynAE, an evaluation framework for assessing how well synthetic benchmarks for multi-turn, tool-calling agents replicate and augment the characteristics of real data trajectories. SynAE assesses the validity, fidelity, and diversity of synthetic data across four metric categories: (i) task instructions and intermediate responses, (ii) tool calls, (iii) final outputs, and (iv) downstream evaluation. We evaluate SynAE using recent agent benchmarks and test common synthetic data failure modes via realistic and controlled generation schemes. SynAE detects fine-grained variations in data validity, fidelity and diversity, and shows that no single metric is sufficient to fully characterize synthetic data quality, motivating a multi-axis evaluation of synthetic data for agent testing. A demo of SynAE is available at https://synae-2026-synae-demo.static.hf.space/index.html, with code at https://github.com/wsqwsq/SynAE.

AI.tldr: SynAE是一个用于评估多轮工具调用型智能体合成基准数据集质量的框架，通过四个维度（任务指令、工具调用、最终输出、下游评估）评估合成数据的有效性、保真度和多样性，证明了多轴评估的必要性。
AI.motivation: 实际生产数据集常存在数据不足、敏感信息或稀疏性等问题，不适合直接用于测试。研究者转向使用合成数据替代，但缺乏量化评估合成数据与真实数据关系的方法。
AI.method: 提出了SynAE评估框架，从四个维度（任务指令与中间响应、工具调用、最终输出、下游评估）评估合成数据的有效性、保真度和多样性，并设计可控的生成方案测试常见合成数据失败模式。
AI.result: SynAE能够检测合成数据在有效性、保真度和多样性方面的细粒度差异，验证了多维度评估的必要性——单一指标不足以全面表征合成数据质量。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明单一指标无法完全表征合成数据质量，呼吁采用多轴评估方法综合考量合成数据对智能体测试的有效性。

title: FlyRoute: Self-Evolving Agent Profiling via Data Flywheel for Adaptive Task Routing
summary: Enterprise routers assign queries to expert agents, yet deployed profiles stay static while agents evolve (prompts, tools, models), and developers rarely keep descriptions or exemplars current. We present FlyRoute, a self-evolving profiling framework that grows capability evidence from real traffic: dispatch candidates, quality-gate successful pairs into each agent's success store, periodically distill evidence into learned capability descriptions, and inject those descriptions together with BM25-retrieved successes into an LLM router. To make this flywheel data-efficient, FlyRoute introduces a targeted exploration policy that combines profile uncertainty, BM25 relevance, and lexical novelty, prioritizing under-profiled agents only for plausible queries and avoiding redundant evidence collection. In experiments on our proprietary enterprise developer-support dataset of real routed queries, FlyRoute improves a same-backbone zero-shot LLM router from 72.57% to 78.04% with only five seed queries per agent, showing that profile retrieval already strengthens cold-start routing. After streaming 7,211 labeled training queries through the flywheel, accuracy rises to 89.83% (+17.26pp over zero-shot; +11.79pp over cold start), with consistent gains across four expert domains under standard routing accuracy on single-gold test queries.

AI.tldr: FlyRoute是一个自进化配置框架，通过从真实流量中收集能力证据、质量门控成功案例、周期性蒸馏能力描述和BM25检索注入，解决企业路由中静态配置与动态Agent进化不匹配的问题。在7,211条标注查询上实现89.83%准确率，较零样本提升17.26个百分点。
AI.motivation: 企业路由器将查询分配给专家Agent，但部署的配置文件保持静态，而Agent却在不断进化（提示词、工具、模型）。开发者很少维护描述和示例，导致配置过时，路由性能下降。
AI.method: FlyRoute采用自进化"飞轮"框架：(1)从真实流量中收集能力证据；(2)对成功配对进行质量门控后存入成功库；(3)周期性将证据蒸馏为学习到的能力描述；(4)将描述与BM25检索到的成功案例一起注入LLM路由器。关键创新是目标探索策略，结合配置文件不确定性、BM25相关性和词汇新颖性，仅对合理查询优先探索配置不足的Agent。
AI.result: 使用每Agent仅5个种子查询，冷启动路由从72.57%提升至78.04%。经7,211条标注查询流后，准确率达89.83%（较零样本提升17.26pp，较冷启动提升11.79pp），在四个专家领域保持一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 配置文件检索即可显著强化冷启动路由。通过目标探索策略实现数据高效的飞轮运转，仅需少量种子查询即可实现大幅性能提升。

title: Embedding-Based Federated Learning with Runtime Governance for Iron Deficiency Prediction
summary: Recent reviews find that the vast majority of published healthcare federated learning (FL) studies never reach real-world deployment. We developed an embedding-based FL pipeline for iron deficiency prediction from routine full blood count (FBC) data and deployed it across real institutional environments at Amsterdam University Medical Centre (AUMC) and NHS Blood and Transplant (NHSBT), two clinical environments that differ markedly in iron deficiency prevalence, ferritin distribution, and subject populations. A frozen domain-specific haematology foundation model, DeepCBC, performs site-local representation extraction, restricting federated training to a compact downstream classifier and substantially reducing recurrent communication relative to full-encoder federation. The two clinical datasets are structurally not independent and identically distributed (non-IID), with heterogeneity arising from distinct population differences rather than sampling artefacts. Runtime governance is enforced by FLA$^3$, a healthcare-oriented FL platform providing study-scoped execution, policy-based authorisation, and signed audit logging. Standard sample-size-weighted aggregation (FedAvg) reduced the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC-AUC) at both sites relative to local-only training, as the global update was biased towards the larger AUMC distribution. FedMAP, a personalised aggregation method, raised ROC-AUC from 0.9470 to 0.9594 at AUMC and from 0.8558 to 0.8671 at NHSBT relative to local-only training, achieving the highest macro ROC-AUC of 0.9133 and the best macro balanced accuracy overall. These results support personalised aggregation in clinical federations where client sample size and task relevance diverge substantially.

AI.tldr: 本文在真实临床环境中部署了一套“冻结基础模型提取表征 + 联邦训练轻量分类器”的缺铁预测系统，平台为 FLA³（带 XACML 策略授权与签名审计日志的运行时治理）。对比 Local-only、FedAvg、FedProx、FedMAP 四种方案：FedAvg 因按样本量加权而被大体量 AUMC 分布带偏，在两站点 ROC-AUC 均低于本地训练；FedMAP 个性化聚合在两站点取得最高 ROC-AUC（AUMC 0.9470→0.9594，NHSBT 0.8558→0.8671），宏观 ROC-AUC 0.9133、宏观平衡准确率 0.8389 为最佳。结论支持在结构性强异质（non-IID）的临床联邦中采用个性化聚合，并强调治理应在运行时落地。
AI.motivation: 尽管医疗联邦学习研究众多，但仅有约5.2%的研究报告了真实场景应用（其余多因偏差、隐私、泛化、通信与治理合规等方法学缺陷而无法落地）。现实中单机构数据人群过窄，且受隐私法规、机构治理与信任边界限制难以集中数据；不同站点在人群、检测指征、实验室流程、治理要求上差异显著，non-IID 往往是结构性而非偶发的抽样噪声。此外，临床联邦除分布式优化外，还需要研究范围限定、策略授权与事后可审计的运行时治理能力。因此本文在 BloodCounts! 联盟的 AUMC 与 NHSBT 两个真实机构环境做跨机构部署，检验“样本量加权聚合是否会损害站点性能”以及个性化聚合是否更优。
AI.method: 两阶段设计：①站点本地使用冻结的血液学基础模型 DeepCBC（编码器输出后验均值 q_φ(z|x)=N(μ_φ(x), diag(σ_φ²(x))），取 μ_φ(x)∈R^256 作为确定性嵌入，原始 FBC 与嵌入均不出机构；②仅联邦训练下游两层隐藏层 MLP（256→128→64→1，含 BatchNorm、ReLU、dropout p=0.3，共 41,601 可训练参数）。聚合方法比较 Local-only、FedAvg、FedProx（μ_p=0.05）、FedMAP（本地优化视为 MAP 估计，学习 ICNN 正则化器 R(θ;θ_g,ψ)=f_ψ(θ,θ_g)+α‖θ−θ_g‖²+ε(‖θ‖²+‖θ_g‖²)，聚合权重 ω_k ∝ P(D_k|θ_k)·exp(−R)，即按后验似然×正则项而非仅样本数加权；ICNN 学习率 1e-5，每轮 3 步）。所有联邦方法统一 50 轮、batch 256、学习率 1e-3、每轮 10 个本地 epoch、patience=3 早停，阈值在验证集上调优。标签为铁蛋白 <15 µg/l（WHO 标准）。运行时治理依托 FLA³（基于 Flower 的 SuperLink/SuperNode 架构），研究范围隔离、XACML 默认拒绝的策略授权、append-only 签名审计日志，越窗推参的节点在网络传输前即被策略引擎拒绝。
AI.result: 数据：AUMC 训练 44,032 例（阳性率 2.8%，铁蛋白充足中位 602 ng/ml，IQR 144–1505），NHSBT（INTERVAL 献血人群）训练 30,997 例（阳性率 19.5%，中位 39 ng/ml，IQR 25–63）；阳性率相差近一个数量级，两站点前五判别性嵌入维度完全不重叠，确证结构性 non-IID。测试结果：Local-only ROC-AUC AUMC 0.9470 / NHSBT 0.8558（宏观 0.9014），平衡准确率 0.8964 / 0.7344（宏观 0.8154）；FedAvg 反而降至 0.9380 / 0.8432（宏观 0.8906），因 AUMC 样本量约为 NHSBT 的 1.4 倍而被带偏；FedProx 部分回补至 0.9446 / 0.8487（宏观 0.8967）；FedMAP 最优，ROC-AUC 0.9594 / 0.8671，宏观 0.9133，宏观平衡准确率 0.8389，NHSBT 平衡准确率 0.7879 为所有方法最高（AUMC 0.8899，略低于本地训练的 0.8964）。通信量方面，同步完整 DeepCBC 编码器每轮约需多传三个数量级的参数。
AI.conclusion: 在结构性强异质的双站点临床联邦中，样本量加权的 FedAvg 会同时损害两端性能；个性化聚合（FedMAP）能在不共享原始数据的前提下在两站点均超越本地训练，取得最高宏观 ROC-AUC 与最佳宏观平衡准确率，支持“聚合权重应反映任务相关性而非仅数据量”的结论。方法论层面提出四条经验：结构性异质应被视为临床属性（须描述标签的临床来源而非仅报告类别平衡）、嵌入式联邦是医院可落地的部署范式（冻结领域基础模型在站点本地做表征提取，仅同步轻量分类器头，兼具数据效率优势）、当客户端规模与任务相关性背离时个性化聚合更有利、治理必须在运行时操作化（越权推参、嵌入外泄、超范围参与等均需被运行时阻断并可事后追责，而静态协议无法做到）。局限：未做成员推断/梯度反演等隐私攻击评估，未量化个性化聚合的运行时开销与全编码器同步的对比成本，嵌入异质性为定性描述且未做方法间配对显著性检验，仅双站点证据、泛化性有限，未评估校准性，冻结编码器存在时间漂移监控需求；AUMC 因炎症导致铁蛋白右移，WHO 15 µg/l 阈值灵敏度偏低，临床可用 30 µg/l 作阈值再优化。

title: Echo: Learning from Experience Data via User-Driven Refinement
summary:
Static "human data" faces inherent limitations: it is expensive to scale and bounded by the knowledge of its creators. Continuous learning from "experience data" - interactions between agents and their environments - promises to transcend these barriers. Today, the widespread deployment of AI agents grants us low-cost access to massive streams of such real-world experience. However, raw interaction logs are inherently noisy, filled with trial-and-error and low information density, rendering them inefficient for direct model training.
  We introduce Echo, a generalized framework designed to operationalize the transition from raw experience to learnable knowledge, effectively "echoing" environmental feedback back into the training loop for model optimization. In today's agent ecosystem, user refinement serves as a primary source of such feedback: driven by responsibility for the outcome, users rigorously transform flawed agent proposals into verified solutions. These user-driven refinement sequences inherently distill agents' crude attempts into high-quality training signals. Echo systematically harvests these signals to continuously align the agent with real-world needs. Large-scale validation in a production code completion environment confirms that Echo effectively harnesses this pipeline, breaking the static performance ceiling by increasing the acceptance rate from 25.7% to 35.7%.

AI.tldr: Echo是一个将原始交互经验转化为可训练知识的通用框架，通过系统化利用用户修正行为作为环境反馈信号，在生产代码补全场景中将接受率提升10个百分点，证明了从"经验数据"持续学习的可行性和有效性。
AI.motivation: 静态人类数据面临可扩展性差、成本高、且受限于创建者知识边界的固有局限。传统方法依赖人工标注数据，效率低下且难以持续优化。
AI.method: Echo框架将原始交互日志转化为可学习知识，系统性地利用用户修正序列作为环境反馈信号。用户通过将不完美的智能体输出修正为验证解的过程，本质上是对粗糙尝试的蒸馏，形成高质量训练信号。
AI.result: 在生产级代码补全环境中验证，智能体接受率从25.7%显著提升至35.7%，证明该方法能有效打破静态性能天花板。
AI.conclusion: Echo框架在生产代码补全环境中验证有效，将接受率从25.7%提升至35.7%，打破了静态性能上限，证明了通过用户修正信号持续对齐AI智能体的可行性。

title: HarnessAPI: A Skill-First Framework for Unified Streaming APIs and MCP Tools
summary: Every Python function deployed as an LLM tool must today exist in two forms: an HTTP endpoint for human-facing clients and CI pipelines, and an MCP tool registration for agent runtimes such as Claude and Cursor. These representations share business logic yet diverge in all the surrounding machinery (routing, validation, serialisation, streaming, and schema maintenance), and they drift apart as the underlying code evolves. We present HarnessAPI, a Python framework that eliminates this duplication by treating a typed skill folder as the single source of truth. From one handler.py plus Pydantic schemas, the framework automatically derives a streaming HTTP endpoint with Server-Sent Events, an interactive OpenAPI/Swagger UI, and a zero-configuration MCP tool, all served from a single process. Dual-mode content negotiation lets the same handler serve SSE-streaming and JSON-returning clients with no handler changes. A dynamic code-generation mechanism ensures Pydantic type annotations propagate correctly to FastMCP's inspection layer, resolving a technical limitation that prevents naive closure-based registration. Measured across six representative skills using cloc, HarnessAPI reduces framework-facing boilerplate by 74% compared with a manually maintained dual-stack implementation (FastAPI server + FastMCP server). HarnessAPI subclasses FastAPI, inheriting its full middleware, dependency-injection, and deployment ecosystem. It is available at https://github.com/edwinjosechittilappilly/harnessapi and on PyPI (pip install harnessapi)

AI.tldr: HarnessAPI 是一个 Python 框架，通过“skill 优先（skill-first）”架构把一个类型化的 skill 文件夹（handler.py + Pydantic models）作为唯一真实来源，自动派生出 SSE 流式 HTTP 端点、OpenAPI/Swagger UI 与零配置 MCP 工具，并由单一进程同时服务两者；在 6 个代表性 skill 上用 cloc 测量，框架层样板代码较手写双栈（FastAPI + FastMCP）减少 74%（170 行 → 44 行），且框架成本为 O(1) 而非 O(n)。
AI.motivation: 作为 LLM 工具部署时，同一份业务逻辑必须同时以 HTTP 端点（面向人/仪表盘/CI 流水线）和 MCP 工具注册（面向 Claude、Cursor、Copilot 等 agent 运行时）两种形式存在，二者共享业务逻辑却各自重复路由、校验、序列化、流式传输与 schema 定义，且随代码演进而逐渐漂移。文献表明 88.6% 的 MCP 服务器背后是既有 REST 服务（双份维护负担），而 schema 缺失或过期会显著加剧 LLM 的 API 幻觉调用。根因是架构性的：FastAPI 是“路由优先”（注册动作即路由装饰器），FastMCP 是“工具优先”且完全不懂 HTTP，开发者被迫夹在中间手工同步两份定义。作者认为 skill（带类型契约的能力单元）才是开发者实际的心智模型，而两种现有框架都不把 skill 作为一等实体。
AI.method: 提出 skill-first 架构模式并给出四个关键实现机制：(1) 生命周期管理——HarnessAPI 继承 fastapi.FastAPI，将 FastMCP 的 lifespan 与用户 lifespan 合并为嵌套上下文管理器，再把 FastMCP 作为 ASGI 子应用挂载到 /mcp；(2) 技能发现——SkillsDirectoryProvider 扫描目录，为每个 skill 创建合成包命名空间（_harness_skills.<name>），用 importlib 按文件路径加载 handler.py / models.py，避免多个 skill 同名 Input/Output 类冲突；元数据按 skill.toml > SKILL.md front-matter > docstring > 文件夹名优先级合并；(3) HTTP 路由——SkillRoute 继承 APIRoute，先用 model_validate 校验（失败统一返回 422 JSON），再按 Accept 头内容协商分流 JSON 缓冲路径或 SSE 流式路径，并用 asyncio.wait_for 实现每技能超时；(4) MCP 注册——因 FastMCP 通过 __globals__ 解析类型注解，闭包捕获 Pydantic 模型会导致 NameError，故用 exec 在显式包含模型的命名空间中动态编译 wrapper 函数，注解得以正确传播；此外提供 handler 热替换端点（沙箱编译并替换 edit_handler）、CLI 脚手架（init / --skill / --skills-dir / --function AST 解析生成模型）。评测采用 cloc v2.0 统计框架层非空非注释行（排除业务逻辑与模型声明），在 Echo、Greet、Summarize、VectorNorm、Classify、Translate 六个 skill 上对比手写双栈与 HarnessAPI，并以功能对照表和 agentskills.io 兼容性测试补充验证。
AI.result: 框架层样板代码从 170 行（103 HTTP + 67 MCP）降至 44 行，降幅 74.1%，各 skill 区间 68–79%；关键结构性结论是扩展性差异——HarnessAPI 成本在技能数上为 O(1)（入口文件不增长），手写方案为 O(n)（每技能至少一个路由装饰器加一个 @mcp.tool），推算 10 个技能时手写约 283 行而 HarnessAPI 仍约 44 行，且手写方案中每一行都是 HTTP 与 MCP 表示可能分叉的位置。功能对照表显示 HarnessAPI 同时具备 HTTP 端点、MCP 工具、OpenAPI/Swagger、同路由 JSON 回退、内容协商、每技能超时、技能级 MCP 开关、agentskills.io 兼容与单进程部署，而 FastAPI/FastMCP 均无法原生提供。对 12 个公开 agentskills.io 格式 skill 目录的导入注册全部成功无需改源码，元数据优先级亦验证通过。局限方面：仅 6 个作者自写 skill、绝对降幅应视为示意性；未做端到端延迟与并发基准（依赖 FastAPI ASGI 特性的间接推断）；Pydantic 类型覆盖仅验证平铺模型、Optional、Literal、List/Dict，复杂 Union 与深层嵌套 BaseModel 存在潜在边界问题；MCP 层尚不支持按工具认证，任何可达 /mcp 的客户端都可调用全部技能，多租户部署需前置认证代理。安全上，enable_edit_endpoints 等同于远程代码执行，框架在启动时若检测到非回环地址即抛 RuntimeError；exec 编译的 MCP wrapper 命名空间被严格限制但会被 Bandit 等静态工具默认告警，仓库中以 .bandit 排除并注明理由，计划在 FastMCP 显式 schema API 发布后彻底移除。
AI.conclusion: 结论认为 HarnessAPI 的价值不在于 74% 这一数字本身，而在于把“保持两份注册同步”从开发纪律转变为框架强制保证的结构性不变式：skill 文件夹成为可分发、可版本化的部署单元，HTTP 与 MCP schema 由同一 Pydantic 模型派生，漂移在结构上不可能发生。随着 agent 生态成熟、单个开发者部署数十乃至数百个技能，手写双栈注册的复利式维护负担将日益不可行，正确的应对不是更好的双注册维护工具，而是彻底消除第二次注册。作者提出后续方向：每技能独立认证配置、文件系统监听实现免重启热加载、以 FastMCP 显式 schema API 取代 exec 包装、以及构建类似 PyPI 的技能注册中心。框架以 MIT 许可开源，代码、文档与六个评测 skill 已在 GitHub 与 PyPI（pip install harnessapi）发布。

title: Hy-MT2: A Family of Fast, Efficient and Powerful Multilingual Translation Models in the Wild
summary: Hy-MT2 is a family of fast-thinking multilingual translation models designed for complex real-world scenarios. It includes three model sizes: 1.8B, 7B, and 30B-A3B (MoE), all of which support translation among 33 languages and effectively follow translation instructions in multiple languages. For on-device deployment, with AngelSlim 1.25-bit extreme quantization, the 1.8B model requires only 440 MB of storage and improves inference speed by 1.5x. Multi-dimensional evaluations show that Hy-MT2 delivers outstanding performance across general, real-world business, domain-specific, and instruction-following translation tasks. The 7B and 30B models outperform open-source models such as DeepSeek-V4-Pro and Kimi K2.6 in fast-thinking mode, while the lightweight 1.8B model also surpasses mainstream commercial APIs from providers such as Microsoft and Doubao overall.

AI.tldr: Hy-MT2 是一个快速思考型多语言翻译模型系列，包含 1.8B、7B 和 30B-A3B（MoE）三种规模，支持 33 种语言间的翻译。通过 1.25-bit 极端量化，1.8B 模型仅需 440MB 存储且推理速度提升 1.5 倍，适配设备端部署。该模型在多维评估中表现出色，大模型版本优于开源竞品，小模型版本超越主流商业 API。
AI.motivation: 当前多语言翻译模型面临三大挑战：①复杂真实场景下的翻译质量与指令遵循能力不足；②大模型的高计算成本限制了实际部署；③现有开源和商业模型在快速推理模式下性能仍有较大提升空间。
AI.method: 采用 AngelSlim 1.25-bit 极端量化技术实现模型压缩；同时通过多语言指令微调提升模型对翻译指令的遵循能力；模型架构涵盖密集型（1.8B、7B）和混合专家型（30B-A3B MoE）两种设计。
AI.result: 在快速思考模式下，7B 和 30B 模型优于 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 和 Kimi K2.6 等开源模型；轻量级 1.8B 模型整体表现超越 Microsoft、Doubao 等主流商业 API；全系列在通用、业务、领域专用及指令遵循翻译任务中均表现优异。
AI.conclusion: Hy-MT2 通过极低比特量化实现了设备端部署能力，1.8B 模型仅需 440MB 存储空间，推理速度提升 1.5 倍，兼具高效性与实用性。

title: Leveraging Self-Paced Curriculum Learning for Enhanced Modality Balance in Multimodal Conversational Emotion Recognition
comment: Accepted at Neural Computing and Applications (Springer), 2026
summary: Multimodal Emotion Recognition in Conversations (MERC) is a crucial task for understanding human interactions, where multimodal approaches integrating language, facial expressions, and vocal tone have achieved significant progress. However, modality misalignment and imbalanced learning remain major challenges, limiting the effective utilization of multimodal information. To address this issue, we propose a plug-and-play framework based on Self-Paced Curriculum Learning (SPCL) for MERC. We introduce a dual-level Difficulty Measurer that captures both utterance-level and conversation-level challenges. The utterance-level score models fine-grained modality-specific difficulty, while the conversation-level score captures broader dialogue structures, including emotional dependencies and modality coherence. Based on these scores, the Learning Scheduler dynamically guides training from easier to more difficult instances. By integrating SPCL into existing MERC architectures, our method alleviates modality imbalance and improves model robustness. Extensive experiments on the IEMOCAP and MELD datasets demonstrate consistent improvements across different architectures and modality settings. On IEMOCAP, SPCL improves weighted F1-score by approximately +1.2% to +6.6% over baseline models, while on MELD, gains reach up to +10.4%. These results highlight the effectiveness and generalizability of SPCL as a lightweight plug-and-play module for multimodal emotion recognition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于自步课程学习的即插即用框架解决多模态对话情感识别中的模态对齐失衡问题，通过双层难度测量器和动态学习调度器提升模型鲁棒性，实验验证该方法的有效性和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态情感识别面临模态对齐失衡和不平衡学习两大挑战，限制了多模态信息的有效利用。
AI.method: 提出基于自步课程学习(SPCL)的即插即用框架，引入双层难度测量器(话语级和对话级)来评估模态特定难度和对话结构特征，由学习调度器根据难度分数动态引导训练从易到难。
AI.result: 在IEMOCAP上加权F1提升+1.2%至+6.6%，MELD上提升达+10.4%，且在多种架构和模态设置下均表现出一致的改进。
AI.conclusion: SPCL作为一种轻量级即插即用模块，能够有效提升多模态对话情感识别的性能，具有良好的泛化能力和实际应用价值。

title: ECPO: Evidence-Coupled Policy Optimization for Evidence-Certified Candidate Ranking
summary: Ranking systems used in decision-support settings should not only order candidates but also expose evidence that can be independently checked. We study evidence-certified candidate ranking: given an intent_id, a predefined plan skeleton, a window-local candidate roster, and text-derived candidate trajectories with span provenance, a system must output a Top-K list together with doc_id:span evidence certificates whose cited spans are sufficient to recover the decision. We instantiate this task on MAVEN-ERE and RAMS with fixed upstream extraction, window-local randomized candidate identifiers, skeleton-aligned trajectory supervision, hard negatives, and audit references. We introduce Evidence-Coupled Policy Optimization (ECPO), a listwise policy-optimization objective whose action is the joint object of ranking and evidence certificate. ECPO first learns an interpretable trajectory reward from skeleton alignment, argument consistency, and optional graph features; it then optimizes a constrained policy with three coupled rewards: listwise ranking utility, span-level certificate validity, and an evidence-cycle reward computed by a label-free deterministic verifier that reconstructs candidate support from claim-stripped cited spans. This reframes the goal from maximizing ordinary NDCG alone to maximizing CertNDCG and decision-evidence coupling. The evaluation compares ECPO against zero-shot, SFT, and GRPO policies, RM-only scoring with deterministic evidence attachment, grammar/JSON-constrained decoding, validator retry, best-of-N RM selection, and post-hoc evidence rationalization under closed-roster, predicted-roster, and hybrid-roster settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ECPO（Evidence-Coupled Policy Optimization），将“候选排序”与“可机检证据证书”作为联合动作对象进行策略优化：策略一次生成 Top-K 排序及与每个候选绑定的 doc_id:span 证据包，训练目标由列表级排序效用（可解释的骨架对齐轨迹奖励）、span 级证书有效性、以及由无标签确定性验证器（剥离候选声明、事件 ID、名次、分数后从证据反推候选）计算的证据循环奖励三项耦合而成。在 MAVEN-ERE/RAMS 的封闭候选池设置下，ECPO 的 vCertNDCG@10 达 0.58/0.40、Slot-EVIDCONS@10 达 0.65/0.49、盲评人类比较支持度 0.76/0.69，显著优于 GRPO、GRPO+Cert、RM-only+Det 等匹配对照，且在留出验证器 B/C、跨骨干（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-14B）、HotpotQA 溯源接口下优势保持；但普通 NDCG 与运行成本仍是显式权衡（RM-only+Det 的 NDCG 更高且更快）。
AI.motivation: 决策支持类排序系统不能只输出一个分数：分析人员需要知道哪些源文本片段支撑了某个候选、这些片段是否落在公开证据范围内、以及证据是否真正区分了该候选与备选。已有偏好优化（RLHF/GRPO 等）只依赖标量奖励模型，容易把不可验证甚至捏造的“证据”一起强化；事后的流畅解释也无法保证可审计性（可读性、归因、忠实性可能相互背离）。此外，已有“证据/忠实性”指标语义混杂：证据包可能只是可解析但无支撑、可溯源到候选 A 却无法说明 A 为何优于 B、或对人类足够却过不了自动匹配器。因此本文：(1) 提出把排序与证据证书耦合为一个动作的输出接口；(2) 把验证一致性纳入优化目标而非事后过滤；(3) 拆分并分别度量有效性、可溯源性、槽位保持、排名盲恢复、人类支持等五种性质；(4) 给出包含留出验证器、反事实证据、跨骨干/跨 schema 与盲评人工审计的构造效度协议。
AI.method:
任务与接口：每个 ranking window w 含证据范围 D_w、有限候选池 C_w、预定义四阶段（PREP→PROBE→EXECUTE→OUTCOME）软序 plan skeleton S_w，以及带 doc_id:[l,r) 溯源的候选轨迹 τ_w(c)；策略只见窗口内随机化候选 ID，输出 y=(A,E)，A 为 Top-K（K=min(10,|C_w|)）有序列表，E 为逐槽与骨架步对齐的证据包（未匹配步显式为 matched:false / event_id:null / evidence:[]）；确定性校验器强制严格 JSON、名册内不重复候选、恰好 k 槽×M 步、证书对齐、文档与边界合法、轨迹/阶段/角色兼容。
奖励学习：用动态规划把有序骨架与观测事件对齐，局部得分 role_sat − λ_arg·arg_viol（不匹配为 −δ_type），回溯后得到覆盖/角色/软序/时序及可选图特征 φ；R_θ(τ;S_w)=θᵀφ 通过窗口级最大似然 + 同窗口（正例、困难近邻、扰动）偏好对的 Bradley–Terry 项学习。
Verifier-A：同文档内触发/论元 span 采用严格 IoU>0.50 匹配（先测触发，再测角色一致的论元），支持分 A(b,c)=0.30·StepCov+0.20·RoleSat+0.25·Trace+0.10·Prec−0.15·BadSpan；权重在训练前固定且不使用开发/测试标签；指派需 A(b,c_best)≥0.55 且与次优差 ≥0.10，否则弃答；用最大权一对一匹配防止重复使用。
证据耦合奖励：r_rank 为窗口组内归一化的折扣轨迹奖励；r_cert 为校验通过且步覆盖率高的槽位均值；r_cycle 为剥离答案性字段后由 Verifier-A 读回原候选的槽位比例；总奖励 r_ECPO = r̄_rank + λ_cert r_cert + λ_cycle r_cycle − ξ_inv·I_invalid − ξ_miss·(k−|A|)_+ − β_KL·KL_tok（γ=0.90、λ_cert=0.5、λ_cycle=1.0、两个惩罚 2.0、组大小 8、裁剪 0.2、β_KL=0.05），用 GRPO 式组归一化优势更新 Qwen3-8B + QLoRA 策略，R_θ 与 Verifier-A 在策略阶段冻结；推理期附加证据契约审计回路并保留弃答。
实验：MAVEN-ERE（718 窗口：576/71/71）与 RAMS（896 窗口：716/90/90），文档级划分、窗口内随机化 ID、冻结抽取器轨迹；对照含 SFT、GRPO、GRPO+Cert（同样 r_cert 但去掉 r_cycle）、RM-only+Det；外部效度用留出验证器 B（无学习成分、覆盖度替 IoU）、C（原始文本重抽取+别名/共指映射）、反向转移 ECPO-B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Qwen3-14B、HotpotQA，以及 120 窗口/3240 单元的盲评人工审计（Krippendorff α=0.71，20% 重标）。
AI.result: 主结果（K=10）：ECPO 在 MAVEN-ERE/RAMS 取得 NDCG 0.70/0.61、Slot-EVIDCONS@10 0.65/0.49、vCertNDCG@10 0.58/0.40、留出 B 下 RankRecover 0.55/0.42、FeasibleRate 0.94/0.92；对照中 RM-only+Det 的普通 NDCG 更高（0.72/0.63）但证据指标全面更低（vCertNDCG 0.49/0.36），GRPO 仅 0.39/0.27。机制消融 −r_cycle 使 vCertNDCG 从 0.58/0.40 跌至 0.43/0.29，而 NDCG 仅从 0.70/0.61 降到 0.68/0.59，隔离出证据耦合项的贡献。构念效度：ECPO-A 在验证器 B 下 0.55/0.38、C 下 0.53/0.36，相对 RM-only+Det 的配对增益为 B +0.07[0.03,0.11]/+0.04[0.01,0.07]、C +0.06[0.02,0.10]/+0.03[0.01,0.06]；反向转移 ECPO-B 在 A/C 下为 0.56/0.39 与 0.52/0.36；排名盲恢复中 ECPO-A 的 RankRecover 比 RM-only+Det 高 +0.14[0.08,0.20]/+0.12[0.06,0.18]且弃答率更低。反事实检验：同候选随机 span 仍保留目标恢复 0.52/0.40，但 RankRecover 从 0.55/0.42 掉到 0.25/0.18、B 下 vCertNDCG 掉到 0.30/0.21；把一个证书替换为同窗未选中候选的等长等阶段有效证书后原目标恢复塌缩至 0.14/0.11，说明“可比性支持”与“可溯源性”必须分离。人工盲评：ECPO 比较支持 0.76/0.69、集合支持 0.72/0.56、名次支持 0.57/0.44，均优于 RM-only+Det（+0.12[0.07,0.17]/+0.10[0.05,0.15]）。迁移：Llama-3.1-8B（+0.12/+0.09 对 GRPO）、Qwen3-14B（+0.12/+0.10）、HotpotQA（0.31→0.39 对 GRPO，0.35→0.39 对 RM-only+Det）。稳健性：47 种 Verifier-A 配置下 vCertNDCG 为 M 0.55–0.60、R 0.38–0.42，方法排序在 45/47 与 43/47 设置中保持；Oracle 上界显示固定名册预测证据 oracle 0.72/0.54、源标注 oracle 0.86/0.76，说明上游表示是瓶颈。成本：RM-only+Align 0.18 s/window，ECPO 额外每语料-种子 76 GPU 小时、单次解码 3.1 s/window，奖励模型 8 GPU 小时。
AI.conclusion: 论文给出了三件贡献物：一个把有序候选列表与候选链接的溯源证据包耦合起来的排序接口；一个把列表级效用、确定性证书有效性与证据循环一致性联合起来的训练目标（组件层面均为已知的 DP 对齐、Bradley–Terry、组归一化优势、KL 正则）；以及一套把槽位可溯源性、排名盲重建、留出验证器迁移、反事实敏感性与盲评人工判断分开测量的审计协议。在所测封闭名册溯源设置下，ECPO 相对匹配对照（GRPO、GRPO+Cert、RM-only+Det）在验证器审计的可溯源性、排名盲恢复与人类比较支持上取得一致增益，且在留出验证器、不同 8B/14B 骨干与 HotpotQA 溯源 schema 下持续成立；但更强的确定性排序器在普通 NDCG（0.72/0.63 vs 0.70/0.61）与成本（0.18 vs 3.1 s/window，另有 76 GPU 小时训练）上占优，构成显式部署权衡——当排序与证据必须作为同一个可审计对象生成时 ECPO 更合适。局限包括：全部主实验依赖封闭有限名册、固定抽取器、候选链接溯源与自动支持契约；验证器 B/C 仅改变评估器形式而保留名册与本体；两个主数据集均为事件中心，HotpotQA 仅增加一种溯源 schema；自动分数本质是验证器相对的，人工审计样本有限，上游表示限制了可用证据上限。

title: Faithful-MR1: Faithful Multimodal Reasoning via Anchoring and Reinforcing Visual Attention
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a promising paradigm for advancing complex reasoning in large language models, and recent work extends RLVR to multimodal large language models (MLLMs). This transfer, however, surfaces a faithfulness challenge: faithful perception of task-relevant visual evidence and faithful use of that evidence during reasoning, leading to unsatisfactory gains on multimodal benchmarks. Specifically, existing perception supervision often operates on textual descriptions rather than natively on image regions, and faithful use is largely overlooked, exposing the perception-reasoning disconnect where correctly perceived evidence is dropped or contradicted during reasoning. To close these gaps, we propose Faithful-MR1, a training framework that anchors and reinforces visual attention to address both halves of faithful multimodal reasoning. The Anchoring stage turns perception into an explicit pre-reasoning subtask, supervising a dedicated <Focus> token's attention directly against image regions rather than through textual descriptions. The Reinforcing stage exposes faithful use through counterfactual image intervention, rewarding answer-correct trajectories that concentrate visual attention where vision causally matters. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Faithful-MR1 outperforms recent multimodal reasoning baselines on both Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct 3B and 7B backbones while using substantially less training data.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多模态大语言模型 RLVR 训练中的忠实度问题，提出Faithful-MR1框架，通过锚定阶段直接在图像区域监督<Focus> token注意力，以及强化阶段利用反事实图像干预奖励因果关键区域的注意力聚焦，在保证推理正确的同时强化视觉感知的忠实度。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR扩展至多模态大语言模型时存在忠实度挑战：感知监督依赖文本描述而非原生图像区域，且忽视了对证据的忠实使用，导致感知-推理脱节——正确感知的证据在推理中被丢弃或矛盾。
AI.method: 提出Faithful-MR1框架，包含两个阶段：(1) 锚定阶段：使用<Focus> token直接在图像区域上监督视觉注意力，而非通过文本描述；(2) 强化阶段：通过反事实图像干预暴露Faithful use，奖励视觉注意力集中在因果关键区域的正确轨迹。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct 3B和7B骨干模型上优于近期多模态推理基线，且使用更少训练数据。
AI.conclusion: Faithful-MR1通过锚定和强化视觉注意力，有效解决了多模态推理中的感知-推理脱节问题，在Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct 3B和7B模型上均优于基线，且训练数据更少。

title: Calibration, Uncertainty Communication, and Deployment Readiness in CKD Risk Prediction: A Framework Evaluation Study
comment: 27 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Supplementary materials (S1-S4) included as ancillary file
summary:
Machine learning models for chronic kidney disease (CKD) risk prediction often post strong discrimination scores on internal test sets. Calibration and uncertainty quantification get far less attention, leaving clinicians without reliable information about whether the probability outputs are accurate.
  We trained five classifiers on the UCI CKD dataset (400 patients, 62.5% CKD prevalence): logistic regression, random forest, XGBoost, SVM with Platt scaling, and Gaussian naive Bayes. We evaluated each across calibration quality, conformal prediction coverage, and an eight-criterion deployment readiness framework. A distributional stress-test applied the best-calibrated variant of each model to the open-access MIMIC-IV demo cohort (97 patients, 23.7% CKD) to assess behaviour under prevalence shift and feature missingness. We measured calibration before and after Platt scaling and isotonic regression using Expected Calibration Error and Brier Score, and quantified uncertainty through split conformal prediction targeting 90% marginal coverage.
  All five models reached AUROC 1.00 on the UCI test set. Isotonic recalibration reduced internal ECE to 0.000-0.022. On MIMIC-IV, AUROC fell to 0.48-0.58, ECE rose to 0.68-0.76, and conformal coverage dropped from 0.80-0.98 to 0.21-0.25 against a 90% target. No model scored above 4 out of 16 on the deployment readiness checklist.
  Near-perfect internal performance did not transfer. Calibration stability and conformal coverage should be evaluated on external data before any clinical prediction model moves toward deployment.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了机器学习模型在内部测试集上的优异性能无法泛化至外部数据的问题，强调了在校准和不确定性量化方面进行严格外部验证的必要性。
AI.motivation: 慢性肾病风险预测的机器学习模型虽在内部测试集上表现出色，但校准和不确定性量化研究不足，导致临床医生缺乏可靠的概率输出信息。
AI.method: 在UCI CKD数据集（400例患者，62.5%患病率）上训练了5种分类器（逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost、SVM with Platt scaling、高斯朴素贝叶斯），并在MIMIC-IV演示队列（97例患者，23.7%患病率）上进行了分布压力测试。使用ECE和Brier分数评估校准质量，通过分 split conformal prediction 量化不确定性，目标为90%边缘覆盖率。
AI.result: 所有模型在UCI测试集上AUROC均达到1.00，等渗重校准将ECE降至0.000-0.022。然而在MIMIC-IV上，AUROC降至0.48-0.58，ECE升至0.68-0.76，共形覆盖率从0.80-0.98降至0.21-0.25（目标90%）。所有模型部署准备度评分均未超过4/16。
AI.conclusion: 内部测试集上的接近完美性能无法转移到外部数据。校准稳定性和共形覆盖应在外部数据上评估后，临床预测模型才能进入部署阶段。

title: Ishigaki-IDS-Bench: A Benchmark for Generating Information Delivery Specification from BIM Information Requirements
comment: 7 pages; benchmark data and evaluation scripts are available on GitHub and Hugging Face
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used to generate structured outputs such as JSON, SQL, and code, yet public resources remain limited for evaluating generation that must simultaneously satisfy industry-standard XML and domain vocabulary constraints. This paper presents Ishigaki-IDS-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating the ability to generate Information Delivery Specification (IDS) XML from Building Information Modeling (BIM) information requirements. The benchmark contains 166 BIM/IDS expert-authored and verified examples created by expanding 83 practical scenarios into Japanese and English, corresponding gold IDS files, and metadata for input format, language, turn setting, IFC version, and construction domain. Its evaluation combines IDSAuditTool-based Processability, Structure, and Content audits with content-agreement evaluation against gold IDS files. In zero-shot evaluation over 10 LLMs, the best model reaches 65.6% macro F1 for content agreement, while only 27.7% of outputs pass the Content audit. These results show that current LLMs can express part of the information requirements as IDS, but still struggle to stably generate XML that satisfies the IDS standard and IFC vocabulary constraints. Ishigaki-IDS-Bench supports comparative evaluation, failure analysis, and the development of constrained structured generation methods that conform to domain standards. We release the evaluation scripts and benchmark data under the CC BY 4.0 license on GitHub and Hugging Face.

AI.tldr: Ishigaki-IDS-Bench 是首个面向 BIM 信息需求→IDS（Information Delivery Specification）XML 生成的公开基准，含 166 条由 6 位 BIM/IDS 专家编写的日英双语示例（源自 83 个真实场景）及对应 gold IDS 与五轴元数据；采用"IDSAuditTool 形式合法性审计（Processability/Structure/Content）+ facet 级内容一致性 macro-F1"两阶段评测，10 个 LLM 零样本最好成绩为 Facet F1 65.6%（GPT-5.5）、Content 通过率 33.1%（Claude Opus 4.5），说明当前 LLM 尚难稳定生成符合 IDS 标准与 IFC 词表约束的 XML。数据（CC BY 4.0，Hugging Face DOI 10.57967/hf/8873）与评测脚本（Apache-2.0，Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20550510）已开源。
AI.motivation: LLM 生成结构化输出（JSON/SQL/代码）已较常见，但在真实产业场景中，仅语法合法的输出远远不够：还须同时满足行业标准格式（如 IDS 1.0 的 XML/XSD）、领域词表（IFC 概念、属性集约定）、版本约束以及外部校验工具（buildingSMART IDSAuditTool）的判定。现有结构化生成基准（XGrammar、Grammar-Aligned Decoding 等）多面向通用 schema；专业领域基准（LawBench、LeDQA、EDINET-BENCH、ECKGBench）以及 BIM 领域已有工作（建筑规范解读、BIM 合规检查、IFC-Agent、MCP4IFC 等）则聚焦问答、检索、模型理解与编辑，缺少"直接由信息需求文档生成 IDS，并同时用外部验证器与 gold IDS 双向打分"的公开基准。因此需要专门评测"符合领域标准的结构化生成"能力。
AI.method: 1) 基准构建：由 6 位 BIM/IDS 专家（5 位具 buildingSMART 相关经验、5 位具 IFC/IDS 实践）头脑风暴约 100 个候选取舍整合为 83 个实际场景，手工编写自然语言/CSV 输入与 gold IDS，经语义评审、IDSAuditTool 校验、facet scorer 复跑及日英语术语一致性检查，再扩展为日/英双语共 166 例；产物含 245 条 specification、945 个 facet。2) 任务定义：输入为需求文档（CSV 或自然语言）+ 输出文件名 + 一个或多个目标 IFC 版本，输出为完整符合 IDS 1.0 的 IDS；仅评测 entity/attribute/property 三类 facet（classification、material、partOf 排除）；多轮设置中模型需根据固定历史（含先前 IDS 草稿与修订请求）输出最终完整 IDS。3) 两阶段评测：阶段一用 IDSAuditTool v1.0.96 给出 Processability（可提取）/Structure（XML 与 IDS XSD 有效）/Content（符合 IDS 标准与 IFC 词表）三项通过率；阶段二用 facet scorer 将 gold 与生成结果规范化为"applicability/requirements + facet 类型 + 约束内容"的比较块多重集做精确匹配，计算 property 的 dataType/cardinality，逐样本宏平均得 Precision/Recall/F1（不使用 LLM-as-judge）。4) 实验：2026 年 5 月对 10 个闭源与开源权重模型做零样本评测，统一系统提示、无示例、不截断、不修复、不重采样，按模型族固定解码参数。
AI.result: 零样本结果：GPT-5.5(xhigh) 的 Facet F1 最高为 65.6%（Recall 65.8/Precision 65.6），但 Content 通过率仅 27.7%；Claude Opus 4.5 的 Content 通过率最高 33.1%，Facet F1 仅 42.2%；Gemini 3.1 Pro 为 52.2%。开源权重中 Kimi K2.6（Processability 99.4、Content 22.3、Facet F1 48.4）优于 DeepSeek V4 Pro（40.0）、Qwen3.5-397B（26.8）、gpt-oss-120b（21.6）与 Qwen3 系列小模型（~20–22%，Qwen3-32B Processability 仅 37.3%、Qwen3-8B 26.5%）。总体呈"高 Processability、低 Content"的系统性落差，且 Qwen 家族规模增大时 Facet F1 大致上升但审计通过率非单调。GPT-5.5 在多轮 44 例上 Content 79.5%、Facet F1 84.8%，显著高于单轮 122 例的 9.0% 与 58.6%；CSV 输入 Facet F1 77.3% 高于自然语言 59.2%。三类失败模式：可提取但违反 IDS XSD/标准/IFC 词表；entity/attribute facet 较易恢复而 property facet（属性集名、cardinality、值约束）错误频发；自然语言中需求目标与值约束映射歧义导致 facet 遗漏或过生成。
